Enumeration of axis orientation values for CRS axes (north, south, east, west, up, down, or other). Used by functions such as OSRGetAxis/OSRSetAxes to describe axis directions.

Enumeration describing how data axis order maps to CRS axis order: traditional GIS (x,y), authority-compliant, or custom. Used with OSRGet/SetAxisMappingStrategy and OSRGet/SetDataAxisToSRSAxisMapping.
Enumeration of high-level Coordinate Reference System categories (geographic 2D/3D, geocentric, projected, vertical, compound, or other). Used inside OSRCRSInfo.

Structure describing metadata of a CRS (authority/code/name/type/deprecation flag/area of use bounding box/area name/projection method/celestial body). Not intended to be directly allocated by client code; created and returned by OSRGetCRSInfoListFromDatabase and freed with OSRDestroyCRSInfoList.

objects.definition: typedef struct OSRCRSListParameters OSRCRSListParameters;
objects.description: Opaque forward-declared struct for optional parameters to OSRGetCRSInfoListFromDatabase(). The concrete layout is not defined in this header.

Tree node used to represent tokens/values of a WKT spatial reference parse tree. Supports children management, value access/mutation, cloning, and WKT import/export. Typically used internally by OGRSpatialReference but exposed for fine-grained WKT manipulation. Includes a nested Listener interface to be notified of node modifications.
Abstract callback interface to be notified when an OGR_SRSNode changes. Register via OGR_SRSNode::RegisterListener().

Reference-counted representation of a spatial reference system (CRS). Provides rich import/export (WKT, PROJ, EPSG, XML, etc.), manipulation of parameters, axis mapping, authority codes, dimensionality, validation, and projection helper setters. Internally owns a parse tree of OGR_SRSNode nodes and a PIMPL Private state.
Custom deleter for smart pointers managing OGRSpatialReference with intrusive reference counting. Calls Release() on non-null pointers.

Abstract interface for transforming coordinates between two spatial references. Exposes source/target SRS access, 3D/4D transformation methods, optional error code reporting, bounds transformation, cloning, and retrieval of an inverse transformation. Implementations (e.g., PROJ-based) derive from this.

Opaque options holder for creating coordinate transformations. Uses PIMPL Private. Allows specifying area of interest, desired accuracy, ballpark allowance, only-best selection, and an explicit operation string and direction. Passed to OGRCreateCoordinateTransformation along with source/target SRS.

Factory function returning a new coordinate transformation between source and target spatial references using default options. The returned pointer must be destroyed with OGRCoordinateTransformation::DestroyCT() if required by implementation, or deleted if documented elsewhere. Construction details beyond signature are not visible here.
Factory function returning a new coordinate transformation using provided OGRCoordinateTransformationOptions. Ownership semantics same as the overload without options.
direct_api_constructors: OGRCreateCoordinateTransformation(const OGRSpatialReference *, const OGRSpatialReference *, const OGRCoordinateTransformationOptions &)

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_memcmp
functions.signature: static inline int CPL_afl_friendly_memcmp(const void *ptr1, const void *ptr2, size_t len)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for memcmp() used when AFL_FRIENDLY is defined with GCC. Compares two memory regions byte-by-byte for len bytes and returns the difference between the first mismatching bytes, or 0 if equal. Intended to be deterministic and simple for fuzzing instrumentation.
requirements: ptr1 must be a valid pointer to a buffer readable for at least len bytes.
ptr2 must be a valid pointer to a buffer readable for at least len bytes.
len may be zero; in that case, the function returns 0 without reading memory.
The two memory regions may overlap since only reads occur, but overlapping is not required.

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_strcmp
functions.signature: static inline int CPL_afl_friendly_strcmp(const char *ptr1, const char *ptr2)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for strcmp(). Compares two C strings byte-by-byte until a mismatch or a NUL terminator is found. Returns the difference between the first differing characters (unsigned char promotion), or 0 if equal.
requirements: ptr1 must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
ptr2 must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
Neither ptr1 nor ptr2 may be NULL.

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_strncmp
functions.signature: static inline int CPL_afl_friendly_strncmp(const char *ptr1, const char *ptr2, size_t len)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for strncmp(). Compares up to len characters of two C strings, stopping early at a NUL terminator. Returns the difference between the first differing characters, or 0 if equal within len or until a terminator.
requirements: ptr1 must be a valid pointer to memory readable for at least min(len, strlen(ptr1)+1) bytes (until the first NUL encountered during comparison).
ptr2 must be a valid pointer to memory readable for at least min(len, strlen(ptr2)+1) bytes (until the first NUL encountered during comparison).
len may be zero; in that case, the function returns 0 without reading memory.
Neither ptr1 nor ptr2 may be NULL.

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_strcasecmp
functions.signature: static inline int CPL_afl_friendly_strcasecmp(const char *ptr1, const char *ptr2)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for strcasecmp(). Case-insensitively compares two NUL-terminated strings by uppercasing both bytes using toupper() and returning their first difference, or 0 if equal.
requirements: ptr1 must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
ptr2 must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
Locale assumptions are not specified; uses toupper() on unsigned char values as implemented.
Neither ptr1 nor ptr2 may be NULL.

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_strncasecmp
functions.signature: static inline int CPL_afl_friendly_strncasecmp(const char *ptr1, const char *ptr2, size_t len)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for strncasecmp(). Case-insensitively compares up to len characters of two strings by uppercasing bytes and returning the first difference, or 0 if equal within len or until a terminator.
requirements: ptr1 must be readable for at least min(len, strlen(ptr1)+1) bytes (until the first NUL encountered during comparison).
ptr2 must be readable for at least min(len, strlen(ptr2)+1) bytes (until the first NUL encountered during comparison).
len may be zero; in that case, the function returns 0 without reading memory.
Neither ptr1 nor ptr2 may be NULL.

functions.name: CPL_afl_friendly_strstr
functions.signature: static inline char *CPL_afl_friendly_strstr(const char *haystack, const char *needle)
functions.description: A fuzzer-friendly replacement for strstr(). Performs a straightforward substring search of needle within haystack and returns a pointer to the first match or NULL if not found. Note: despite const inputs, it returns a non-const char* for compatibility with strstr-like usage in this header.
requirements: haystack must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
needle must point to a NUL-terminated string readable up to and including its terminator.
Return value is either NULL or a pointer within haystack; do not modify through the returned pointer if the original data are const.

functions.name: vsnprintf
functions.signature: int vsnprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, va_list args)
functions.description: Header declares a (possibly deprecated under GDAL build flags) vsnprintf() to encourage using CPL wrappers. Writes formatted output to str according to fmt using a va_list. Returns the number of characters that would have been written (excluding the NUL) or a negative value on error.
requirements: str must point to a buffer with capacity of at least size bytes if size > 0.
If size is greater than 0, str must not be NULL; behavior for size == 0 with str == NULL is implementation-defined and not guaranteed by this header.
fmt must be a valid format string, and the provided arguments in args must match the format specifiers.
The output is NUL-terminated if size > 0.
Caller must check the return value for truncation (return >= size) or errors (negative).

functions.name: snprintf
functions.signature: int snprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, ...)
functions.description: Header declares a (possibly deprecated under GDAL build flags) snprintf(). Writes formatted output to str according to fmt and additional arguments. Returns the number of characters that would have been written (excluding the NUL) or a negative value on error.
requirements: str must point to a buffer with capacity of at least size bytes if size > 0.
If size is greater than 0, str must not be NULL; behavior for size == 0 with str == NULL is implementation-defined and not guaranteed by this header.
fmt must be a valid format string with arguments that match the specifiers.
The output is NUL-terminated if size > 0.
Caller must check the return value for truncation (return >= size) or errors (negative).

functions.name: sprintf
functions.description: Header declares a (possibly deprecated) sprintf(). Writes formatted output to str according to fmt and additional arguments. Unlike snprintf, no size limit is provided; use with care to avoid buffer overflows.
requirements: str must point to a writable buffer large enough to hold the entire formatted output plus the terminating NUL; the function does not perform bounds checking.
fmt must be a valid format string with arguments that match the specifiers.
Caller must check the return value for errors (negative) and ensure sufficient buffer capacity to avoid overflow.

functions.name: cpl::fits_on
functions.signature: template <typename T> inline T cpl::fits_on(T t)
functions.description: Utility to indicate that the result of an arithmetic operation fits in the specified type T. Primarily used to silence static analyzer warnings; it simply returns its argument unchanged.
requirements: Available only in C++ when GDAL_COMPILATION is defined (per header guards).
T must be a valid, copyable type for which return by value is well-formed.

functions.name: cpl::contains
functions.signature: template <typename C, typename V> inline bool cpl::contains(const C &container, const V &value)
functions.description: C++ helper emulating C++20 container.contains(value). Returns true if container.find(value) != container.end(). Intended for associative containers that implement find().
requirements: Available only in C++ when GDAL_COMPILATION is defined (per header guards).
C must provide member functions find(const Key&) and end() returning an iterator comparable for inequality.
value must be a type acceptable by C::find(value) (typically comparable to the container's key type).
The container must remain valid during the call; no concurrent modifications that invalidate iterators.

functions.name: CPLVerifyConfiguration
functions.description: Performs a runtime self-check of CPL configuration settings and invariants. Intended to be called early during process initialization for diagnostics.
requirements: May be called at any time; typically early in program startup

functions.name: CPLIsDebugEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether CPL debug output is enabled (based on configuration/environment). Use to guard debug logging.

functions.name: CPLGetConfigOption
functions.signature: const char *CPL_STDCALL CPLGetConfigOption(const char *pszKey, const char *pszDefault);
functions.description: Gets the value of a configuration option by key, looking at thread-local, process, and environment scope as implemented by CPL. Returns pszDefault if the option is unset.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetThreadLocalConfigOption
functions.signature: const char *CPL_STDCALL CPLGetThreadLocalConfigOption(const char *pszKey, const char *pszDefault);
functions.description: Gets the value of a thread-local configuration option. Returns pszDefault if the option is unset for the current thread.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetGlobalConfigOption
functions.signature: const char *CPL_STDCALL CPLGetGlobalConfigOption(const char *pszKey, const char *pszDefault);
functions.description: Gets the value of a global (process-wide) configuration option (not thread-local). Returns pszDefault if the option is unset.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLSetConfigOption
functions.signature: void CPL_STDCALL CPLSetConfigOption(const char *pszKey, const char *pszValue);
functions.description: Sets or unsets a process-wide configuration option. Passing NULL pszValue typically unsets the option.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszValue may be NULL to unset; if non-NULL it must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLSetThreadLocalConfigOption
functions.signature: void CPL_STDCALL CPLSetThreadLocalConfigOption(const char *pszKey, const char *pszValue);
functions.description: Sets or unsets a thread-local configuration option for the current thread. Passing NULL pszValue typically unsets the option.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszValue may be NULL to unset; if non-NULL it must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLDeclareKnownConfigOption
functions.description: Declares a configuration option as known/recognized along with an associated definition or documentation string. Useful for tooling and diagnostics.
requirements: pszKey must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszDefinition must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetKnownConfigOptions
functions.description: Returns a list (CSL string list) of known configuration options. Caller owns and must free with CSLDestroy/VSIFree as per CPL string list conventions.
requirements: Caller must free the returned list with the appropriate CPL/CSL deallocator

functions.name: CPLSubscribeToSetConfigOption
functions.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when configuration options are set/unset. Returns a subscriber id to manage the subscription.
requirements: pfnCallback must be a valid function pointer
Returned subscriber id must be retained if unsubscription is desired later

functions.name: CPLUnsubscribeToSetConfigOption
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered configuration option change callback using the id returned by CPLSubscribeToSetConfigOption.
requirements: nSubscriberId must be the id returned by a prior successful CPLSubscribeToSetConfigOption call

functions.name: CPLFreeConfig
functions.description: Internal cleanup of configuration option storage. Typically called by CPL cleanup routines. Not usually needed by applications.
requirements: Should only be called when no other threads are concurrently accessing config options

functions.name: CPLGetConfigOptions
functions.description: Returns all current config options as a CSL string list of KEY=VALUE. Caller must free the list.
requirements: Caller must free the returned list with the appropriate CPL/CSL deallocator

functions.name: CPLSetConfigOptions
functions.description: Sets multiple process-wide config options from a NULL-terminated string list of KEY=VALUE pairs. Replaces or augments current options as per implementation.
requirements: papszConfigOptions must be a NULL-terminated array of C strings of the form KEY=VALUE; may be NULL for no-op

functions.name: CPLGetThreadLocalConfigOptions
functions.description: Returns the current thread's config options as a CSL string list of KEY=VALUE. Caller must free the list.
requirements: Caller must free the returned list with the appropriate CPL/CSL deallocator

functions.name: CPLSetThreadLocalConfigOptions
functions.description: Sets multiple thread-local config options from a NULL-terminated KEY=VALUE list for the current thread.
requirements: papszConfigOptions must be a NULL-terminated array of C strings of the form KEY=VALUE; may be NULL for no-op

functions.name: CPLLoadConfigOptionsFromFile
functions.description: Loads configuration options from a file and installs them as current options. When bOverrideEnvVars is non-zero, loaded values may override environment-derived values.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid path to a readable file
bOverrideEnvVars is treated as boolean (0/!=0)

functions.name: CPLLoadConfigOptionsFromPredefinedFiles
functions.description: Loads configuration options from predefined default locations/files as defined by CPL.

functions.name: CPLMalloc
functions.description: Allocates a block of memory of nSize bytes. Wrapper over VSI allocators with fatal error on failure per CPL conventions.
requirements: nSize may be zero or positive; behavior on zero-size follows CPL/VSI semantics

functions.name: CPLCalloc
functions.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array of nCount elements of nSize bytes each. Wrapper over VSI allocators with fatal-on-failure semantics.
requirements: nCount and nSize should be such that nCount*nSize does not overflow size_t

functions.name: CPLRealloc
functions.description: Changes the size of a memory block previously allocated by CPLMalloc/CPLCalloc/CPLRealloc to nNewSize. Wrapper with CPL semantics.
requirements: pOld may be NULL to behave like CPLMalloc
nNewSize may be zero; semantics follow CPL/VSI realloc behavior

functions.name: CPLStrdup
functions.description: Duplicates a C string using CPL allocation routines. Returns a newly allocated null-terminated copy.
requirements: pszStr must be a non-NULL, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLStrlwr
functions.description: Converts a string to lowercase in place. Returns pszStr.
requirements: pszStr must be a non-NULL, modifiable, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLFGets
functions.description: Reads a line from a FILE* into pszBuffer, at most nBufferSize-1 chars, and strips CR/LF. Returns pszBuffer on success or NULL on EOF/error.
requirements: pszBuffer must be non-NULL and at least nBufferSize bytes
nBufferSize must be > 0
fp must be a valid, open FILE* for reading

functions.name: CPLReadLine
functions.description: Reads the next line from a standard FILE*, stripping line endings. Returns an internal static buffer pointer valid until next call on the same thread/context.
requirements: fp must be a valid, open FILE* for reading
Caller must copy the returned string if it needs to persist across subsequent calls

functions.name: CPLReadLineL
functions.description: Reads the next line from a VSILFILE*, stripping line endings. Returns pointer to internal buffer valid until next read.
requirements: fpL must be a valid, open VSILFILE* for reading
Caller must copy the returned string if it needs to persist across subsequent calls

functions.name: CPLReadLine2L
functions.signature: const char *CPLReadLine2L(VSILFILE *fpL, int nMaxCols, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Reads a line from VSILFILE* with additional controls such as maximum column count and options. Returns internal buffer pointer.
requirements: fpL must be a valid, open VSILFILE* for reading
nMaxCols should be positive when used as a limit
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of KEY=VALUE

functions.name: CPLReadLine3L
functions.signature: const char *CPLReadLine3L(VSILFILE *fpL, int nMaxCols, int *pnSkippedBytes, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Reads a line from VSILFILE* with column limit and reports skipped bytes (e.g., for exceedingly long lines). Returns internal buffer pointer.
requirements: fpL must be a valid, open VSILFILE* for reading
pnSkippedBytes may be NULL or must point to valid int storage if non-NULL
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of KEY=VALUE

functions.name: CPLAtof
functions.description: Converts an ASCII string to double. Not locale-aware; accepts both '.' and ',' depending on CPL rules.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLAtofDelim
functions.description: Converts an ASCII string to double using a specified decimal separator (not locale-aware).
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLStrtod
functions.description: strtod-like conversion of string to double. Not locale-aware. Writes end-pointer if non-NULL.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
ppszEnd may be NULL or point to char* storage

functions.name: CPLStrtodM
functions.description: Like CPLStrtod but accepts both '.' and ',' as decimal separators (locale-agnostic).
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
ppszEnd may be NULL or point to char* storage

functions.name: CPLStrtodDelim
functions.signature: double CPLStrtodDelim(const char *pszStr, char **ppszEnd, char chDecimalSep);
functions.description: Converts string to double using the specified decimal separator and stores end-pointer if requested.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
ppszEnd may be NULL or point to char* storage

functions.name: CPLStrtof
functions.description: Converts string to float (single precision), locale-agnostic. End pointer optionally returned.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
ppszEnd may be NULL or point to char* storage

functions.name: CPLStrtofDelim
functions.signature: float CPLStrtofDelim(const char *pszStr, char **ppszEnd, char chDecimalSep);
functions.description: Converts string to float using specified decimal separator and returns end pointer optionally.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
ppszEnd may be NULL or point to char* storage

functions.name: CPLAtofM
functions.description: Converts a number to double in a locale-agnostic way that supports both '.' and ',' as decimal separators.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLScanString
functions.signature: char *CPLScanString(const char *pszInput, int nMaxChars, int nMaxWords, int nEndChar);
functions.description: Scans an ASCII string for a token/substring up to constraints and returns a newly allocated string. Behavior is CPL-specific.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree/VSIFree

functions.name: CPLScanDouble
functions.description: Parses a double value from the beginning of a string, scanning up to nMaxChars.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxChars should be >= 0

functions.name: CPLScanLong
functions.description: Parses a long integer from the beginning of a string, scanning up to nMaxChars.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxChars should be >= 0

functions.name: CPLScanULong
functions.signature: unsigned long CPLScanULong(const char *pszInput, int nMaxChars);
functions.description: Parses an unsigned long integer from the beginning of a string, scanning up to nMaxChars.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxChars should be >= 0

functions.name: CPLScanUIntBig
functions.description: Parses an unsigned big integer (GUIntBig) from the beginning of a string.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxChars should be >= 0

functions.name: CPLAtoGIntBig
functions.description: Converts a C string to a signed big integer (GIntBig).
requirements: pszString must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLAtoGIntBigEx
functions.signature: GIntBig CPLAtoGIntBigEx(const char *pszString, int bWarn, int *pbOverflow);
functions.description: Converts a C string to GIntBig, with optional warning and overflow reporting.
requirements: pszString must be a valid, null-terminated string
pbOverflow may be NULL or must point to valid int storage

functions.name: CPLScanPointer
functions.description: Parses a pointer value from a string (implementation-defined format) scanning up to nMaxChars.
requirements: pszInput must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxChars should be >= 0

functions.name: CPLPrintString
functions.signature: int CPLPrintString(char *pszBuffer, const char *pszStr, int nMaxLen);
functions.description: Formats a string into a buffer, truncating/padding as needed. Returns number of characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must point to a writable buffer of at least nMaxLen bytes
pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxLen must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLPrintStringFill
functions.signature: int CPLPrintStringFill(char *pszBuffer, const char *pszStr, int nMaxLen);
functions.description: Formats a string into a buffer, filling unused space (implementation-specific). Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must point to a writable buffer of at least nMaxLen bytes
pszStr must be a valid, null-terminated string
nMaxLen must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLPrintInt32
functions.signature: int CPLPrintInt32(char *pszBuffer, GInt32 nValue, int nMaxLen);
functions.description: Formats a 32-bit signed integer into a buffer. Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must be writable with capacity >= nMaxLen
nMaxLen must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLPrintUIntBig
functions.signature: int CPLPrintUIntBig(char *pszBuffer, GUIntBig nValue, int nMaxLen);
functions.description: Formats an unsigned big integer into a buffer. Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must be writable with capacity >= nMaxLen
nMaxLen must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLPrintDouble
functions.signature: int CPLPrintDouble(char *pszBuffer, const char *pszFormat, double dfValue, const char *pszLocale);
functions.description: Formats a double into a buffer with specified format and locale handling. Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must be writable
pszFormat must be a valid printf-style format string for doubles
pszLocale may be NULL or a locale identifier string

functions.name: CPLPrintTime
functions.signature: int CPLPrintTime(char *pszBuffer, int nMaxLen, const char *pszFormat, const struct tm *ptm, const char *pszLocale);
functions.description: Formats a struct tm time into a buffer with specified format and locale. Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must be writable with capacity >= nMaxLen
nMaxLen must be >= 0
pszFormat must be a valid strftime-style format string
ptm must point to a valid struct tm
pszLocale may be NULL or a locale identifier string

functions.name: CPLPrintPointer
functions.description: Formats a pointer value into a buffer. Returns characters written.
requirements: pszBuffer must be writable with capacity >= nMaxLen
nMaxLen must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLFormatReadableFileSize
functions.description: C++: Formats a size in bytes into a human-readable string (e.g., KB, MB, GB).

functions.name: CPLGetSymbol
functions.description: Fetches the address of a symbol from a shared library/DLL. Returns NULL on failure.
requirements: pszLibrary must be a valid library identifier/path per platform conventions
pszSymbolName must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetExecPath
functions.description: Retrieves the absolute path of the current executable into pszPathBuf. Returns 0/1 depending on success (implementation-defined).
requirements: pszPathBuf must be writable with capacity >= nMaxLength
nMaxLength must be > 0

functions.name: CPLGetPath
functions.description: Returns the directory component of a path (C API), as a pointer to an internal/static buffer or allocated string per CPL path API. Deprecated in some C++ builds.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string
Caller should copy/duplicate the result if persistence is required (per CPL path API conventions)

functions.name: CPLGetDirname
functions.description: Returns the directory name portion of a path.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetBasename
functions.description: Returns the base name (filename without extension and path).
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetExtension
functions.description: Returns the file extension (without dot) from a path.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLFormFilename
functions.signature: const char *CPLFormFilename(const char *pszPath, const char *pszBasename, const char *pszExtension);
functions.description: Forms a filename from path, base name, and extension. Returns a composed string.
requirements: pszPath may be NULL or a valid path string
pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszExtension may be NULL or a valid extension string

functions.name: CPLFormCIFilename
functions.signature: const char *CPLFormCIFilename(const char *pszPath, const char *pszBasename, const char *pszExtension);
functions.description: Forms a case-insensitive filename combination (semantics are CPL-specific).
requirements: pszPath may be NULL or a valid path string
pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszExtension may be NULL or a valid extension string

functions.name: CPLResetExtension
functions.description: Resets or sets the extension of a filename and returns the new path.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path
pszNewExt may be NULL or a valid extension without dot

functions.name: CPLProjectRelativeFilename
functions.description: Resolves a secondary filename relative to a project directory, returning a combined path.
requirements: pszProjectDir must be a valid, null-terminated directory path
pszSecondaryFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLCleanTrailingSlash
functions.description: Returns a path with trailing slashes normalized/removed.
requirements: pszPath must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGenerateTempFilename
functions.description: Generates a temporary filename using the provided stem/prefix and system temp directory rules.
requirements: pszStem may be NULL or a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLExpandTilde
functions.description: Expands a leading tilde '~' in a path to the user's home directory.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLLaunderForFilename
functions.description: Launders/sanitizes a string to be safe for filenames, optionally considering an output path.
requirements: pszName must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszOutputPath may be NULL or a valid, null-terminated path

functions.name: CPLGetCurrentDir
functions.description: Returns the current working directory as a newly allocated string. Caller must free.
requirements: Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree/VSIFree

functions.name: CPLGetFilename
functions.description: Returns the filename component (last path element) from a path.
requirements: pszPath must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLIsFilenameRelative
functions.description: Returns non-zero if a filename is relative (not absolute), zero otherwise. Platform-specific rules apply.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLExtractRelativePath
functions.signature: const char *CPLExtractRelativePath(const char *pszBasePath, const char *pszFilename, int *pbGotRelative);
functions.description: Returns pszFilename with any leading pszBasePath removed if applicable and reports via pbGotRelative whether a relative path was formed.
requirements: pszBasePath must be a valid, null-terminated path
pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path
pbGotRelative may be NULL or must point to valid int storage

functions.name: CPLCorrespondingPaths
functions.description: Rewrites a list of file paths from one root to another, producing a new list of corresponding paths.
requirements: pszOldFilename and pszNewFilename must be valid, null-terminated paths
papszFileList must be a NULL-terminated array of strings
Caller must free the returned list

functions.name: CPLCheckForFile
functions.description: Checks for the existence of a file, optionally considering sibling files. May modify pszFilename to reflect an existing file.
requirements: pszFilename must be a writable buffer containing an initial filename
papszSiblingList may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of sibling filenames

functions.name: CPLGetHomeDir
functions.description: Returns the path to the current user's home directory, or NULL if unknown. Returned pointer may be to an internal buffer.
requirements: Caller should copy the result if persistence is needed

functions.name: CPLGetPathSafe
functions.description: C++: Returns the directory component of a path as an owning std::string.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetDirnameSafe
functions.description: C++: Returns the dirname component as std::string.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetBasenameSafe
functions.description: C++: Returns the base filename without extension as std::string.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGetExtensionSafe
functions.description: C++: Returns the extension (without dot) as std::string.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLFormFilenameSafe
functions.signature: std::string CPLFormFilenameSafe(const char *pszPath, const char *pszBasename, const char *pszExtension = nullptr);
functions.description: C++: Forms a filename from path, basename, and optional extension, returning std::string.
requirements: pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszPath and pszExtension may be NULL

functions.name: CPLFormCIFilenameSafe
functions.signature: std::string CPLFormCIFilenameSafe(const char *pszPath, const char *pszBasename, const char *pszExtension = nullptr);
functions.description: C++: Forms a case-insensitive filename combination (CPL-specific) as std::string.
requirements: pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszPath and pszExtension may be NULL

functions.name: CPLResetExtensionSafe
functions.description: C++: Returns pszFilename with its extension replaced by pszNewExt.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszNewExt may be NULL or a valid extension

functions.name: CPLProjectRelativeFilenameSafe
functions.description: C++: Resolves pszSecondaryFilename relative to pszProjectDir and returns as std::string.
requirements: pszProjectDir and pszSecondaryFilename must be valid, null-terminated strings

functions.name: CPLCleanTrailingSlashSafe
functions.description: C++: Normalizes/removes trailing slash from a path, returning std::string.
requirements: pszPath must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLGenerateTempFilenameSafe
functions.description: C++: Generates a temporary filename using an optional stem, returning std::string.
requirements: pszStem may be NULL or a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLExpandTildeSafe
functions.description: C++: Expands leading '~' in path to home directory, returning std::string.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLLaunderForFilenameSafe
functions.description: C++: Sanitizes a name for safe file naming, optionally using output path, returning std::string.
requirements: pszName must be a valid, null-terminated string
pszOutputPath may be NULL or a valid path string

functions.name: CPLHasPathTraversal
functions.description: Checks if a path contains traversal elements like ".." that could escape a directory root.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLHasUnbalancedPathTraversal
functions.description: Checks if a path contains more ".." components than ordinary components (unbalanced traversal).
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLFindFile
functions.description: Looks up a file by basename within the CPL file-finder stack for a given class/category. Returns a found path or NULL.
requirements: pszClass may be NULL or a category string
pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLDefaultFindFile
functions.description: Default implementation of file finding used by CPL when no custom finders are installed.
requirements: pszClass may be NULL or a category string
pszBasename must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: CPLPushFileFinder
functions.description: Pushes a custom file-finder callback onto the search stack to override file lookup behavior.
requirements: pfnFinder must be a valid function pointer

functions.name: CPLPopFileFinder
functions.description: Pops the most recently pushed file-finder callback and returns it.

functions.name: CPLPushFinderLocation
functions.description: Pushes a directory/location onto the search path used by file finders.
requirements: pszLocation must be a valid, null-terminated path

functions.name: CPLPopFinderLocation
functions.description: Pops the most recently pushed finder location from the search path.

functions.name: CPLFinderClean
functions.description: Cleans up resources associated with the file-finder stack and locations.

functions.name: CPLStat
functions.description: Safe version of stat() that works on platform edge cases (e.g., "C:"). Fills psStatBuf and returns 0 on success, non-zero on failure (platform/CPL semantics).
requirements: pszPath must be a valid, null-terminated path
psStatBuf must be a valid, writable pointer to VSIStatBuf

functions.name: CPLOpenShared
functions.signature: FILE *CPLOpenShared(const char *pszFilename, const char *pszAccess, int bLarge);
functions.description: Opens a FILE* with reference-counted sharing so multiple clients can share the same handle. Returns a shared FILE* or NULL on failure.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path
pszAccess must be a valid fopen-style mode string
bLarge indicates if large-file semantics/VSIFILE* handling are needed (CPL-specific)

functions.name: CPLCloseShared
functions.description: Decrements the reference count on a shared FILE*. Closes the actual handle when the count reaches zero.
requirements: fp must be a FILE* previously returned by CPLOpenShared

functions.name: CPLGetSharedList
functions.description: Returns the internal array of shared file info and optionally the item count. Intended for diagnostics.
requirements: pnListCount may be NULL or must point to writable int storage
Returned pointer is managed by CPL; caller must not free or modify it

functions.name: CPLDumpSharedList
functions.description: Dumps the current shared file list to the given FILE* for debugging.
requirements: fp must be a valid, open FILE* for writing

functions.name: CPLCleanupSharedFileMutex
functions.description: Internal cleanup of the mutex protecting the shared file list. Typically called during CPL cleanup.
requirements: Should not be called concurrently with shared file operations

functions.name: CPLDMSToDec
functions.description: Converts an angle in DMS (degrees-minutes-seconds) textual form to decimal degrees.
requirements: is must be a valid, null-terminated string representing an angle in DMS form

functions.name: CPLDecToDMS
functions.signature: const char *CPLDecToDMS(double dfAngle, const char *pszAxis, int nPrecision);
functions.description: Converts a decimal degree angle to a DMS text string, optionally specifying axis (e.g., N/S/E/W) and precision. Returns an internal buffer pointer.
requirements: pszAxis may be NULL or a valid axis string like "Lat"/"Long"/"X"/"Y"
nPrecision should be >= 0
Caller should copy the result if it must persist across calls

functions.name: CPLPackedDMSToDec
functions.description: Converts a packed DMS numeric value (DDDMMSS.S) to decimal degrees.

functions.name: CPLDecToPackedDMS
functions.description: Converts decimal degrees to a packed DMS numeric value (DDDMMSS.S).

functions.name: CPLStringToComplex
functions.description: Parses a complex number from a string into its real and imaginary components.
requirements: pszString must be a valid, null-terminated string
pdfReal and pdfImag must be non-NULL pointers to writable doubles

functions.name: CPLUnlinkTree
functions.description: Recursively deletes a directory tree or a file at pszPath. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: pszPath must be a valid, null-terminated path

functions.name: CPLCopyFile
functions.description: Copies a single file from old path to new path. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: pszOldPath and pszNewPath must be valid, null-terminated paths

functions.name: CPLCopyTree
functions.description: Recursively copies a directory tree from old path to new path. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: pszOldPath and pszNewPath must be valid, null-terminated paths

functions.name: CPLMoveFile
functions.description: Moves/renames a file or directory from old path to new path. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: pszOldPath and pszNewPath must be valid, null-terminated paths

functions.name: CPLSymlink
functions.signature: int CPLSymlink(const char *pszOldPath, const char *pszNewPath, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Creates a symbolic link from new path to old path, honoring options if supported. Returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
requirements: pszOldPath and pszNewPath must be valid, null-terminated paths
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of KEY=VALUE

functions.name: CPLGetRemainingFileDescriptorCount
functions.description: Returns an estimate of how many additional file descriptors can be opened before reaching system limits (platform-specific heuristic).

functions.name: CPLLockFileEx
functions.signature: CPLLockFileStatus CPLLockFileEx(const char *pszLockFileName, CPLLockFileHandle *phLockFileHandle, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Acquires an inter-process lock using a lock file. On success returns CLFS_OK and sets *phLockFileHandle to a handle to be passed to CPLUnlockFileEx.
requirements: pszLockFileName must be a valid, null-terminated path to a lock file
phLockFileHandle must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the handle
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated KEY=VALUE list

functions.name: CPLUnlockFileEx
functions.description: Releases a lock previously acquired by CPLLockFileEx.
requirements: hLockFileHandle must be a valid handle returned by CPLLockFileEx

functions.name: CPLCreateZip
functions.description: Creates a new ZIP archive and returns a handle to it. Options control compression and metadata.
requirements: pszZipFilename must be a valid, null-terminated output path
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated array of KEY=VALUE strings

functions.name: CPLCreateFileInZip
functions.description: Starts a new file entry inside an open ZIP archive referenced by hZip, with the given filename and options.
requirements: hZip must be a valid handle returned by CPLCreateZip
pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated string
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated array of KEY=VALUE strings

functions.name: CPLWriteFileInZip
functions.signature: CPLErr CPLWriteFileInZip(void *hZip, const void *pBuffer, int nBufferSize);
functions.description: Writes nBufferSize bytes from pBuffer into the current file entry in the ZIP archive.
requirements: hZip must reference an open ZIP with a file entry created
pBuffer must point to at least nBufferSize bytes if nBufferSize > 0
nBufferSize must be >= 0

functions.name: CPLCloseFileInZip
functions.description: Closes the current file entry within the ZIP archive.
requirements: hZip must reference an open ZIP archive with a file entry previously opened

functions.name: CPLAddFileInZip
functions.signature: CPLErr CPLAddFileInZip(void *hZip, const char *pszArchiveFilename, const char *pszInputFilename, VSILFILE *fpInput, CSLConstList papszOptions, GDALProgressFunc pProgressFunc, void *pProgressData);
functions.description: Adds a file to the ZIP archive, reading from the given input filename or fpInput, with options and optional progress callback.
requirements: hZip must be a valid ZIP handle
pszArchiveFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path inside the archive
pszInputFilename may be NULL if fpInput is provided; at least one of pszInputFilename or fpInput must be non-NULL
fpInput, if non-NULL, must be a valid, readable VSILFILE* positioned at the start of the data
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated KEY=VALUE list
pProgressFunc may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must follow GDALProgressFunc contract with pProgressData

functions.name: CPLCloseZip
functions.description: Finalizes and closes the ZIP archive referenced by hZip.
requirements: hZip must be a valid ZIP handle returned by CPLCreateZip

functions.name: CPLZLibDeflate
functions.signature: void *CPLZLibDeflate(const void *ptr, size_t nBytes, int nLevel, void *outptr, size_t nOutAvailableBytes, size_t *pnOutBytes);
functions.description: Compresses nBytes from ptr using zlib deflate at level nLevel, writing to outptr if provided or allocating output buffer when allowed by implementation. Returns pointer to compressed buffer and sets pnOutBytes.
requirements: ptr must point to at least nBytes of input (nBytes may be zero)
nLevel should be a valid zlib compression level (typically 0-9)
If outptr is non-NULL, it must point to at least nOutAvailableBytes writable bytes
pnOutBytes must be a non-NULL pointer to receive output size

functions.name: CPLZLibInflate
functions.signature: void *CPLZLibInflate(const void *ptr, size_t nBytes, void *outptr, size_t nOutAvailableBytes, size_t *pnOutBytes);
functions.description: Decompresses nBytes from ptr using zlib inflate, writing to outptr if provided or allocating as needed per implementation. Returns pointer to decompressed buffer and sets pnOutBytes.
requirements: ptr must point to at least nBytes of compressed input
If outptr is non-NULL, it must point to at least nOutAvailableBytes writable bytes
pnOutBytes must be a non-NULL pointer to receive output size

functions.name: CPLZLibInflateEx
functions.signature: void *CPLZLibInflateEx(const void *ptr, size_t nBytes, void *outptr, size_t nOutAvailableBytes, bool bAllowResizeOutptr, size_t *pnOutBytes);
functions.description: Extended inflate that can optionally resize the output buffer if bAllowResizeOutptr is true. Returns pointer to decompressed buffer and sets pnOutBytes.
requirements: ptr must point to at least nBytes of compressed input
If outptr is non-NULL, it must point to at least nOutAvailableBytes writable bytes unless resizing is allowed
pnOutBytes must be a non-NULL pointer to receive output size

functions.name: CPLValidateXML
functions.signature: int CPLValidateXML(const char *pszXMLFilename, const char *pszXSDFilename, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Validates an XML document against an XSD schema. Returns 0/1 or an error code per CPL semantics.
requirements: pszXMLFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path to an XML file
pszXSDFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path to an XSD file
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of KEY=VALUE

functions.name: CPLsetlocale
functions.description: Thread-safe wrapper protecting setlocale() usage. Returns the previous or current locale string per setlocale semantics.
requirements: category must be a valid LC_* category constant
locale may be NULL or a valid locale string

functions.name: CPLCleanupSetlocaleMutex
functions.description: Cleans up the internal mutex used to serialize setlocale() calls.
requirements: Should not be called while other threads may call CPLsetlocale

functions.name: CPLIsPowerOfTwo
functions.description: Returns non-zero if i is a power of two, zero otherwise.

functions.name: CPLIsInteractive
functions.description: Returns whether the given FILE* stream is interactive (e.g., attached to a terminal/tty).
requirements: f must be a valid FILE*

functions.name: CSLAddString
functions.description: Appends a copy of pszNewString to a NULL-terminated string list (char**), reallocating as needed, and returns the updated list. Use when building/expanding CSL string lists.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated array of char* (may be NULL for an empty list).
pszNewString must be a valid C-string (non-NULL).
Caller owns and must free the returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLAddStringMayFail
functions.description: Like CSLAddString() but may return NULL on failure (e.g., allocation error), instead of aborting. Appends pszNewString to the list and returns the updated list, or NULL on failure.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated array of char* (may be NULL).
pszNewString must be a valid C-string (non-NULL).
Caller must check the return value for NULL before further use.
Caller owns and must free the returned list with CSLDestroy() on success.

functions.name: CSLCount
functions.description: Returns the number of strings in a NULL-terminated string list. Useful for iterating or allocating based on list size.
requirements: papszStrList is either NULL or a NULL-terminated array of const char*.
No ownership is taken.

functions.name: CSLGetField
functions.description: Returns the n-th entry of a string list or an empty string if out of range. Helper for safe access in CSV/CSL contexts.
requirements: papszStrList must be NULL or a NULL-terminated array of const char*.
n is zero-based index; negative indices are out of range and will not crash but exact behavior beyond returning empty string is library-defined.

functions.name: CSLDestroy
functions.description: Frees a string list previously allocated by CSL* functions. Recursively frees each string and the list container.
requirements: papszStrList must be a list allocated by CPL/CSL allocation routines or compatible with their free semantics.
Safe to pass NULL.

functions.name: CSLDuplicate
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of a NULL-terminated string list and returns it.
requirements: papszStrList is NULL or a proper NULL-terminated list.
Caller owns the returned list and must free it with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLMerge
functions.description: Merges two string lists, typically overriding entries in papszOrig with those in papszOverride (for name/value style lists). Returns the merged list (may be papszOrig reallocated).
requirements: papszOrig is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
papszOverride is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).
Caller must use returned pointer for subsequent operations and free with CSLDestroy().
Exact conflict resolution rules are typical of name/value lists; details beyond name/value behavior are not fully specified here.

functions.name: CSLTokenizeString
functions.description: Splits pszString into tokens using default whitespace-like rules and returns a newly allocated NULL-terminated list of tokens.
requirements: pszString must be a valid C-string (non-NULL).
Caller must free the returned list with CSLDestroy().
Tokenization rules are the library defaults; use CSLTokenizeString2 for custom flags.

functions.name: CSLTokenizeStringComplex
functions.signature: char **CSLTokenizeStringComplex(const char *pszString, const char *pszDelimiter, int bHonourStrings, int bAllowEmptyTokens);
functions.description: Splits pszString using delimiters in pszDelimiter, with optional quote honoring and empty-token control. Returns a token list.
requirements: pszString must be a valid C-string.
pszDelimiter must be a valid C-string of delimiter characters (non-NULL).
bHonourStrings and bAllowEmptyTokens are boolean flags (0/1).
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLTokenizeString2
functions.signature: char **CSLTokenizeString2(const char *pszString, const char *pszDelimiter, int nCSLTFlags);
functions.description: Tokenizes pszString with delimiter set and bitwise OR of CSLT_* flags (honor quotes, allow empty, preserve quotes/escapes, strip spaces, etc.). Returns a token list.
requirements: pszString must be a valid C-string.
pszDelimiter must be a valid C-string (non-NULL).
nCSLTFlags is a combination of CSLT_* defines (e.g., CSLT_HONOURSTRINGS, CSLT_ALLOWEMPTYTOKENS, etc.).
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLPrint
functions.description: Prints each string in papszStrList to fpOut, one per line. Returns a status code (non-negative on success).
requirements: papszStrList is NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
fpOut must be a valid FILE* open for writing.
No ownership is transferred.

functions.name: CSLLoad
functions.description: Loads a text file into a string list, one line per entry. Returns the loaded list.
requirements: pszFname must be a valid path to a readable file.
Caller must free the returned list with CSLDestroy().
File size and line length limits are implementation-defined; use CSLLoad2 for explicit limits.

functions.name: CSLLoad2
functions.signature: char **CSLLoad2(const char *pszFname, int nMaxLines, int nMaxCols, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Loads up to nMaxLines lines from pszFname with per-line length up to nMaxCols, applying options if any. Returns a string list of lines.
requirements: pszFname must be a valid readable file path.
nMaxLines >= 0; 0 may mean no limit (exact semantics are library-defined).
nMaxCols >= 0; 0 may mean no limit (exact semantics are library-defined).
papszOptions is a NULL-terminated list of name=value options (may be NULL).
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLSave
functions.description: Saves the string list to a text file, one entry per line. Returns success/failure status.
requirements: papszStrList is NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
pszFname must be a valid path to a writable location.
Existing files may be overwritten (implementation-defined).

functions.name: CSLInsertStrings
functions.description: Inserts multiple lines into a string list at the given index. Returns the updated list pointer.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
nInsertAtLineNo is zero-based; values outside [0..Count] are handled per implementation (typically append/clamp).
papszNewLines is a NULL-terminated list of strings to insert (may be NULL for no-op).
Caller must use and free the returned list pointer with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLInsertString
functions.description: Inserts a single string into a list at the specified index. Returns the updated list.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
nInsertAtLineNo is zero-based; out-of-range handling is implementation-defined (typically append/clamp).
pszNewLine must be a valid C-string.
Caller must free the returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLRemoveStrings
functions.signature: char **CSLRemoveStrings(char **papszStrList, int nFirstLineToDelete, int nNumToRemove, char ***ppapszRetStrings);
functions.description: Removes nNumToRemove strings starting at nFirstLineToDelete from a list. Optionally returns the removed strings via ppapszRetStrings. Returns the updated list.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller.
nFirstLineToDelete >= 0.
nNumToRemove >= 0.
ppapszRetStrings may be NULL; if non-NULL, removed strings are returned and caller becomes responsible for freeing them appropriately (typically CSLDestroy()).
Caller must free the updated list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLFindString
functions.description: Finds the index of pszTarget in the list using case-insensitive comparison. Returns -1 if not found.
requirements: papszList is NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
pszTarget must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CSLFindStringCaseSensitive
functions.description: Finds the index of pszTarget in the list using case-sensitive comparison. Returns -1 if not found.
requirements: papszList is NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
pszTarget must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CSLPartialFindString
functions.description: Returns index of the first string in papszHaystack containing pszNeedle as a substring (search method is partial). Returns -1 if not found.
requirements: papszHaystack is NULL or a NULL-terminated list.
pszNeedle must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CSLFindName
functions.description: Finds the index of an entry whose name (before separator ':' or '=') matches pszName in a name/value formatted string list. Returns -1 if not found.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list of strings formatted as name:value or name=value.
pszName must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CSLFetchBoolean
functions.signature: int CSLFetchBoolean(CSLConstList papszStrList, const char *pszKey, int bDefault);
functions.description: Fetches a boolean value from a name/value list for key pszKey and interprets it (typical true/false tokens). Returns bDefault if not found.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated name/value list (may be NULL).
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.
Interpretation of boolean strings follows CPL conventions (e.g., YES/TRUE/ON/1).

functions.name: CSLTestBoolean
functions.description: Deprecated helper to interpret a C-string as boolean. Returns TRUE(1) or FALSE(0) according to CPL boolean parsing rules.
requirements: pszValue may be NULL; behavior for NULL is library-defined (typically FALSE).
Prefer CPLTestBool() in C++ code per header comment.

functions.name: CPLTestBoolean
functions.description: C API to interpret a string as boolean (legacy int form). Returns 1 or 0 based on CPL boolean parsing rules.
requirements: pszValue may be NULL; behavior is library-defined.
In C++ code, use CPLTestBool() instead (per header comment).

functions.name: CPLTestBool
functions.description: Interprets a string as boolean and returns a C++ bool. Preferred in C++ code.
requirements: pszValue may be NULL; behavior is library-defined.

functions.name: CPLFetchBool
functions.signature: bool CPLFetchBool(CSLConstList papszStrList, const char *pszKey, bool bDefault);
functions.description: Fetches a boolean value from a name/value list as a bool, defaulting to bDefault if not set.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated name/value list (may be NULL).
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLParseMemorySize
functions.description: Parses a memory size string (e.g., numbers with optional units like K/M/G) into a numeric value and indicates if a unit was specified.
requirements: pszValue must be a valid C-string.
pnValue must be a non-NULL output pointer.
pbUnitSpecified may be NULL or non-NULL; if non-NULL it receives whether a unit suffix was present.
Caller must check returned CPLErr for success before using outputs.

functions.name: CPLParseNameValue
functions.description: Parses a name/value string of the form name=value or name:value. Returns a pointer to the value part and outputs the key via ppszKey.
requirements: pszNameValue must be a valid C-string containing a separator '=' or ':'.
ppszKey must be a non-NULL output pointer; memory ownership of the output key follows CPL allocation rules (free with CPLFree() if allocated).
Returned value pointer may refer into pszNameValue or temporary storage; treat as read-only.

functions.name: CPLParseNameValueSep
functions.signature: const char *CPLParseNameValueSep(const char *pszNameValue, char **ppszKey, char chSep);
functions.description: Parses a name/value string using a specified separator character chSep. Returns value pointer and outputs allocated key via ppszKey.
requirements: pszNameValue must be a valid C-string containing chSep.
ppszKey must be a non-NULL output pointer (free with CPLFree() if allocated).
chSep is the separator to use.

functions.name: CSLFetchNameValue
functions.description: Returns the value associated with pszName in a name/value list, or NULL if not found.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated name/value list.
pszName must be a valid C-string key.
Returned pointer is owned by the list; do not free.

functions.name: CSLFetchNameValueDef
functions.signature: const char *CSLFetchNameValueDef(CSLConstList papszStrList, const char *pszName, const char *pszDefault);
functions.description: Returns the value for pszName in a name/value list, or pszDefault if not found.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated name/value list.
pszName must be a valid C-string key.
Returned pointer may be pszDefault; do not free it here.

functions.name: CSLFetchNameValueMultiple
functions.description: Returns all values associated with pszName in a name/value list (for keys occurring multiple times) as a newly allocated list.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated name/value list.
pszName must be a valid C-string key.
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLAddNameValue
functions.description: Appends a name=value (or name:value) entry to a list and returns the updated list pointer.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
pszName and pszValue must be valid C-strings.
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLSetNameValue
functions.description: Sets or updates the entry for pszName in a name/value list to pszValue. Returns the updated list pointer.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
pszName and pszValue must be valid C-strings.
Caller must use returned pointer and free with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CSLSetNameValueSeparator
functions.description: Sets the separator (e.g., '=' or ':') used by name/value entries in the list.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).
pszSeparator must be a valid C-string separator (typically one character).

functions.name: CSLParseCommandLine
functions.description: Parses a command-line string into argument tokens, honoring quotes/escapes as appropriate. Returns a string list of arguments.
requirements: pszCommandLine must be a valid C-string.
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CPLEscapeString
functions.signature: char *CPLEscapeString(const char *pszString, int nLength, int nScheme);
functions.description: Escapes pszString according to the given scheme (backslash, XML, URL, SQL, CSV, etc.). If nLength >= 0 only that many bytes are considered; otherwise uses full string. Returns newly allocated escaped string.
requirements: pszString must be a valid pointer; if nLength >= 0 it must reference at least nLength bytes.
nScheme must be one of CPLES_* constants.
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree() or VSI* compatible free.

functions.name: CPLUnescapeString
functions.description: Unescapes pszString according to nScheme and returns a newly allocated unescaped string. Optionally returns output length via pnLength.
requirements: pszString must be a valid C-string for the selected scheme.
pnLength may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive the unescaped length.
nScheme must be one of CPLES_* constants.
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree() or VSI* compatible free.

functions.name: CPLBinaryToHex
functions.description: Converts binary data to a hex-encoded, NUL-terminated C-string. Returns newly allocated hex string.
requirements: nBytes >= 0.
pabyData must point to at least nBytes bytes (unless nBytes==0).
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLHexToBinary
functions.description: Converts a hex-encoded string to binary. Returns a newly allocated buffer and sets the output byte count in pnBytes.
requirements: pszHex must be a valid hex string (ignoring case).
pnBytes must be a non-NULL pointer to receive output length.
Caller must free returned buffer with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLBase64Encode
functions.description: Base64-encodes nBytes of input into a newly allocated ASCII string. Returns NUL-terminated string.
requirements: nBytes >= 0.
pabyData points to at least nBytes bytes (unless nBytes==0).
Caller must free returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLBase64DecodeInPlace
functions.description: Decodes a base64 string in place, overwriting the input buffer with decoded bytes, and returns the number of decoded bytes.
requirements: pszBase64 must point to a writable NUL-terminated base64 string buffer sufficient to hold decoded data (in-place).
Caller must ensure buffer size is adequate (decoded length <= encoded length).

functions.name: CPLGetValueType
functions.description: Determines whether pszValue looks like an integer, real number, or generic string. Returns an enum value.
requirements: pszValue must be a valid C-string (may be empty).

functions.name: CPLToupper
functions.description: Locale-independent toupper() variant. Converts a single byte character code to upper case and returns it as int.
requirements: Input is typically an unsigned char converted to int or EOF semantics are not specified.
No locale dependence is guaranteed by CPL.

functions.name: CPLTolower
functions.description: Locale-independent tolower() variant. Converts a single byte character code to lower case and returns it as int.
requirements: Input is typically an unsigned char converted to int or EOF semantics are not specified.

functions.name: CPLStrlcpy
functions.signature: size_t CPLStrlcpy(char *pszDest, const char *pszSrc, size_t nDestSize);
functions.description: Safe string copy similar to BSD strlcpy: copies up to nDestSize-1 bytes, NUL-terminates dest if nDestSize > 0, and returns length of src.
requirements: pszDest must be a valid writable buffer of size nDestSize.
pszSrc must be a valid C-string.
nDestSize specifies destination buffer size.

functions.name: CPLStrlcat
functions.signature: size_t CPLStrlcat(char *pszDest, const char *pszSrc, size_t nDestSize);
functions.description: Safe string concatenation similar to BSD strlcat: appends as much of src as fits, NUL-terminates if space permits, and returns the length of the string it tried to create.
requirements: pszDest must be an existing NUL-terminated string buffer of size nDestSize.
pszSrc must be a valid C-string.
nDestSize specifies total destination buffer size.

functions.name: CPLStrnlen
functions.description: Returns the length of pszStr but at most nMaxLen, not scanning past nMaxLen bytes.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid pointer; if not NUL-terminated within nMaxLen, nMaxLen is returned.
nMaxLen is the maximum number of bytes to examine.

functions.name: CPLvsnprintf
functions.signature: int CPLvsnprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, va_list args);
functions.description: Locale-independent vsnprintf-like formatter. Writes formatted output to str with size limit and returns number of characters that would have been written.
requirements: str must be a valid writable buffer of at least size bytes (may be NULL if size==0).
size is the buffer size in bytes.
fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.
args must be initialized with va_start.

functions.name: CPLsnprintf
functions.signature: int CPLsnprintf(char *str, size_t size, const char *fmt, ...);
functions.description: Locale-independent snprintf-like formatter. Writes formatted output with size limit and returns number of characters that would have been written.
requirements: str must be a valid writable buffer of at least size bytes.
size is buffer size in bytes.
fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.

functions.name: CPLsprintf
functions.description: sprintf-like function (may be deprecated in some builds) to write formatted data without explicit size limit into str. Prefer CPLsnprintf.
requirements: str must point to a sufficiently large writable buffer to avoid overflow.
fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.
Use is discouraged; prefer size-bounded variants.

functions.name: CPLprintf
functions.description: printf-like output to standard output with CPL's locale-independent formatting.
requirements: fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.

functions.name: CPLsscanf
functions.description: sscanf-like parser (limited formats) with CPL's locale assumptions. Parses str according to fmt and stores results in provided pointers.
requirements: str must be a valid C-string.
fmt must be a valid scanf-style format string (limited set).
Addresses for output arguments must be valid and of matching types.

functions.name: CPLSPrintf
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a thread-local/static buffer containing formatted text per fmt. Useful for quick formatting without explicit buffers.
requirements: fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.
Returned pointer is transient and may be overwritten by subsequent calls; copy if needed.

functions.name: CSLAppendPrintf
functions.description: Formats a string per fmt and appends it to the list. Returns the updated list pointer.
requirements: papszStrList is a NULL-terminated list owned by caller (may be NULL).
fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.
Caller must free returned list with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: CPLVASPrintf
functions.signature: int CPLVASPrintf(char **buf, const char *fmt, va_list args);
functions.description: Formats text into a newly allocated buffer (assigned to *buf) using a va_list. Returns number of characters written.
requirements: buf must be a non-NULL pointer to a char* output; on success, *buf points to allocated memory to be freed by caller (VSIFree/CPLFree).
fmt must be a valid printf-style format string.
args must be initialized with va_start.

functions.name: CPLEncodingCharSize
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of a character in the specified encoding when it is a fixed-width encoding (e.g., UTF-16/32).
requirements: pszEncoding must be a valid encoding name C-string (e.g., CPL_ENC_UTF8, CPL_ENC_UTF16).

functions.name: CPLClearRecodeWarningFlags
functions.description: Clears internal warning flags related to charset recoding operations.
requirements: No parameters. Safe to call at any time.

functions.name: CPLRecode
functions.signature: char *CPLRecode(const char *pszSource, const char *pszSrcEncoding, const char *pszDstEncoding);
functions.description: Re-encodes the input string from pszSrcEncoding to pszDstEncoding and returns a newly allocated UTF-8 or target-encoded string as appropriate.
requirements: pszSource must be a valid C-string in pszSrcEncoding.
pszSrcEncoding and pszDstEncoding must be valid encoding names.
Caller must free returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLRecodeFromWChar
functions.signature: char *CPLRecodeFromWChar(const wchar_t *pwszSource, const char *pszSrcEncoding, const char *pszDstEncoding);
functions.description: Converts a wide-character string from pszSrcEncoding to pszDstEncoding and returns a newly allocated multibyte string.
requirements: pwszSource must be a valid NUL-terminated wide-character string.
pszSrcEncoding and pszDstEncoding must be valid encoding names.
Caller must free returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLRecodeToWChar
functions.signature: wchar_t *CPLRecodeToWChar(const char *pszSource, const char *pszSrcEncoding, const char *pszDstEncoding);
functions.description: Converts a multibyte string from pszSrcEncoding to a wide-character string in pszDstEncoding. Returns newly allocated wide string.
requirements: pszSource must be a valid C-string.
pszSrcEncoding and pszDstEncoding must be valid encoding names.
Caller must free returned wide string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLIsUTF8
functions.description: Checks whether the given byte sequence is valid UTF-8. Returns non-zero if valid, zero otherwise.
requirements: pabyData must point to at least nLen bytes (or a NUL-terminated string if nLen < 0; exact semantics are library-defined).
nLen is the number of bytes to validate.

functions.name: CPLIsASCII
functions.description: Checks whether the given buffer contains only ASCII characters (<= 0x7F).
requirements: pabyData must point to at least nLen bytes.
nLen is the number of bytes to check.

functions.name: CPLForceToASCII
functions.signature: char *CPLForceToASCII(const char *pabyData, int nLen, char chReplacementChar);
functions.description: Converts input to ASCII by replacing non-ASCII bytes with chReplacementChar. Returns newly allocated NUL-terminated string.
requirements: pabyData must point to at least nLen bytes (or be NUL-terminated if nLen < 0; exact semantics are library-defined).
chReplacementChar is the replacement for non-ASCII bytes.
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLUTF8ForceToASCII
functions.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to ASCII by replacing non-ASCII code points with chReplacementChar. Returns newly allocated NUL-terminated string.
requirements: pszStr must be a valid UTF-8 C-string.
Caller must free the returned string with CPLFree()/VSIFree().

functions.name: CPLStrlenUTF8
functions.description: Deprecated. Returns the number of UTF-8 code points in the string. Use CPLStrlenUTF8Ex() instead.
requirements: pszUTF8Str must be a valid UTF-8 C-string.

functions.name: CPLStrlenUTF8Ex
functions.description: Returns the number of UTF-8 code points in the string with extended/safer semantics than CPLStrlenUTF8.
requirements: pszUTF8Str must be a valid UTF-8 C-string.

functions.name: CPLCanRecode
functions.signature: int CPLCanRecode(const char *pszTestStr, const char *pszSrcEncoding, const char *pszDstEncoding);
functions.description: Tests if pszTestStr can be losslessly recoded from pszSrcEncoding to pszDstEncoding. Returns non-zero if possible.
requirements: pszTestStr must be a valid C-string.
pszSrcEncoding and pszDstEncoding must be valid encoding names.

functions.name: CPLRemoveSQLComments
functions.description: Removes SQL-style comments from the input string and returns the cleaned SQL text.
requirements: osInput is an input string; no special constraints.

functions.name: CPLOPrintf
functions.description: Formats text per printf semantics and returns it as a CPLString.
requirements: pszFormat must be a valid printf-style format string.

functions.name: CPLOvPrintf
functions.description: va_list version of CPLOPrintf. Formats text and returns as CPLString.
requirements: pszFormat must be a valid printf-style format string.
args must be initialized with va_start.

functions.name: CPLQuotedSQLIdentifier
functions.description: Returns pszIdent quoted per SQL identifier rules of the CPL helper (e.g., double-quote and escape internal quotes).
requirements: pszIdent must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CPLURLGetValue
functions.description: Extracts the value of query parameter pszKey from the URL string and returns it (decoded as appropriate).
requirements: pszURL must be a valid URL string.
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLURLAddKVP
functions.signature: CPLString CPLURLAddKVP(const char *pszURL, const char *pszKey, const char *pszValue);
functions.description: Adds or updates key=value in the query part of pszURL and returns the updated URL string.
requirements: pszURL, pszKey, pszValue must be valid C-strings.
Encoding/escaping is handled by the helper; inputs should be raw values.

functions.name: CPLString::Printf
functions.description: Formats into this CPLString using printf-style formatting. Returns reference to self for chaining.
requirements: pszFormat must be a valid printf-style format string.
Existing content is replaced.

functions.name: CPLString::vPrintf
functions.description: va_list variant of Printf. Formats into this string, replacing its contents.
requirements: pszFormat must be a valid printf-style format string.
args must be initialized with va_start.

functions.name: CPLString::FormatC
functions.description: Formats a double value according to pszFormat (or a default) into this string. Returns reference to self.
requirements: pszFormat may be NULL to use a default formatting.
dfValue is the value to format.

functions.name: CPLString::Trim
functions.description: Trims leading and trailing ASCII whitespace from this string in place.
requirements: Operates on the current content; no parameters.

functions.name: CPLString::Recode
functions.description: Re-encodes the current string from pszSrcEncoding to pszDstEncoding and stores result in place.
requirements: pszSrcEncoding and pszDstEncoding must be valid encoding names.

functions.name: CPLString::replaceAll
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences of substring osBefore with osAfter in this string. Modifies in place.
requirements: osBefore may be empty or non-empty; replacing empty has implementation-defined behavior.

functions.name: CPLString::replaceAll
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences of substring osBefore with single character chAfter.
requirements: osBefore is the substring to replace.

functions.name: CPLString::replaceAll
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences of character chBefore with string osAfter.
requirements: None beyond valid parameters.

functions.name: CPLString::replaceAll
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences of character chBefore with chAfter.
requirements: None beyond valid parameters.

functions.name: CPLString::ifind
functions.signature: size_t CPLString::ifind(const std::string &str, size_t pos = 0) const;
functions.description: Case-insensitive search for substring str, starting at position pos. Returns position or npos on failure.
requirements: pos is a starting index within [0..size()].

functions.name: CPLString::ifind
functions.signature: size_t CPLString::ifind(const char *s, size_t pos = 0) const;
functions.description: Case-insensitive search for C-string s, starting at position pos. Returns position or npos on failure.
requirements: s must be a valid C-string.
pos is a starting index within [0..size()].

functions.name: CPLString::toupper
functions.description: Converts all characters in this string to upper case (ASCII/locale-independent per CPL).
requirements: Operates in place.

functions.name: CPLString::tolower
functions.description: Converts all characters in this string to lower case (ASCII/locale-independent per CPL).
requirements: Operates in place.

functions.name: CPLString::endsWith
functions.description: Returns true if this string ends with osStr.
requirements: osStr is the suffix to test.

functions.name: CPLString::URLEncode
functions.description: Returns a URL-encoded version of this string.
requirements: This string is interpreted as raw text to encode.

functions.name: CPLString::SQLQuotedIdentifier
functions.description: Returns this string quoted as an SQL identifier (escaping internal characters appropriately).
requirements: String content should be a valid identifier token prior to quoting.

functions.name: CPLString::SQLQuotedLiteral
functions.description: Returns this string quoted as an SQL string literal (escaping internal quotes).
requirements: No special constraints; returned string includes appropriate literal quoting.

functions.name: CPLStringList::BoundToConstList
functions.description: Wraps a CSLConstList into a CPLStringList without taking ownership, suitable for conversion or iteration.
requirements: papszList is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).
Returned object does not own the underlying list.

functions.name: CPLStringList::Clear
functions.description: Clears the list, freeing owned memory if applicable. Returns reference to self.
