requirements: If the instance owns its list, content is freed.

functions.name: CPLStringList::size
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in the list (same as Count()).
requirements: None.

functions.name: CPLStringList::Count
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.
requirements: None.

functions.name: CPLStringList::empty
functions.description: Returns true if the list is empty.
requirements: None.

functions.name: CPLStringList::AddString
functions.description: Appends a copy of pszNewString to the list and returns reference to self.
requirements: pszNewString must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CPLStringList::AddString
functions.description: Appends a copy of newString to the list and returns reference to self.
requirements: newString is an input string.

functions.name: CPLStringList::AddStringDirectly
functions.description: Appends pszNewString taking ownership of the allocated string pointer (assumed allocated with CPLMalloc()).
requirements: pszNewString must be heap-allocated with CPLMalloc()-compatible allocator and not used elsewhere after call.
Caller transfers ownership to the list.

functions.name: CPLStringList::InsertString
functions.description: Inserts a copy of pszNewLine at position nInsertAtLineNo and returns reference to self.
requirements: nInsertAtLineNo is zero-based; out-of-range handling is implementation-defined (typically append/clamp).
pszNewLine must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CPLStringList::InsertStringDirectly
functions.description: Inserts pszNewLine at position nInsertAtLineNo, taking ownership of the provided allocated string pointer.
requirements: pszNewLine must be heap-allocated with CPLMalloc()-compatible allocator.
After call, caller must not free or use pszNewLine.
nInsertAtLineNo is zero-based.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FindString
functions.description: Returns index of pszTarget (case-insensitive) in the list, or -1 if not found.
requirements: pszTarget must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CPLStringList::PartialFindString
functions.description: Returns index of first element containing pszNeedle as a substring, or -1 if not found.
requirements: pszNeedle must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FindName
functions.description: Finds index of a name in a name/value formatted list and returns it, or -1 if not found.
requirements: List should contain entries formatted as name=value or name:value.
pszName must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FetchBool
functions.signature: bool CPLStringList::FetchBool(const char *pszKey, bool bDefault) const;
functions.description: Gets a boolean value for pszKey from the list as bool, defaulting to bDefault.
requirements: List is treated as name/value.
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FetchBoolean
functions.signature: int CPLStringList::FetchBoolean(const char *pszKey, int bDefault) const;
functions.description: Deprecated helper to get boolean value as int (0/1) for pszKey from the list, defaulting to bDefault.
requirements: List is name/value formatted.
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FetchNameValue
functions.description: Returns the value associated with pszKey or NULL if not found, without modifying the list.
requirements: List is name/value formatted.
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.
Returned pointer is owned by the list; do not free.

functions.name: CPLStringList::FetchNameValueDef
functions.signature: const char *CPLStringList::FetchNameValueDef(const char *pszKey, const char *pszDefault) const;
functions.description: Returns the value for pszKey or pszDefault if not present.
requirements: List is name/value formatted.
pszKey must be a valid C-string key.

functions.name: CPLStringList::AddNameValue
functions.description: Appends a name=value pair to the list and returns reference to self.
requirements: pszKey and pszValue must be valid C-strings.

functions.name: CPLStringList::SetNameValue
functions.description: Sets or updates entry for pszKey to pszValue and returns reference to self.
requirements: pszKey and pszValue must be valid C-strings.

functions.name: CPLStringList::Assign
functions.description: Assigns an external char** list to this object, optionally taking ownership.
requirements: papszListIn is a NULL-terminated list (or NULL).
If bTakeOwnership is TRUE, caller must not free papszListIn; the object will own and free it.
If FALSE, caller must ensure the list outlives this object.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator=
functions.description: Assigns from a char** list, taking ownership as per Assign() default (TRUE).
requirements: papszListIn is a NULL-terminated list (or NULL).
After assignment, the object owns the list; caller must not free it.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator=
functions.description: Copy assignment from another CPLStringList.
requirements: oOther is a valid CPLStringList. No special constraints.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator=
functions.description: Assigns from a CSLConstList by copying its content.
requirements: papszListIn is a NULL-terminated const list (or NULL).

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator[]
functions.description: Returns a modifiable pointer to the i-th string in the list.
requirements: i is zero-based index within [0..size()-1].
Returned pointer is owned by the list; do not free.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator[]
functions.description: Returns a modifiable pointer to the i-th string (size_t overload).
requirements: i must be within bounds.
Returned pointer is owned by the list; do not free.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator[]
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the i-th string.
requirements: i must be within bounds.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator[]
functions.description: Returns a const pointer to the i-th string (size_t overload).
requirements: i must be within bounds.

functions.name: CPLStringList::operator[]
functions.description: Convenience accessor to fetch the value for pszKey in a name/value list (same as FetchNameValue).
requirements: pszKey must be a valid C-string key.
List should be name/value formatted.

functions.name: CPLStringList::front
functions.description: Returns the first element of the list.
requirements: List must be non-empty.

functions.name: CPLStringList::back
functions.description: Returns the last element of the list.
requirements: List must be non-empty.

functions.name: CPLStringList::begin
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the first element for range-based iteration.
requirements: List may be NULL; returned pointer may be NULL when list is empty.

functions.name: CPLStringList::end
functions.description: Returns a pointer one past the last element for range-based iteration.
requirements: Pairs with begin() for iteration.

functions.name: CPLStringList::List
functions.description: Returns the internal char** list. Ownership remains with the object.
requirements: Do not free the returned pointer. Valid until modification or destruction of the object.

functions.name: CPLStringList::List
functions.description: Returns the internal list as a const char** (CSLConstList). Ownership remains with the object.
requirements: Do not free the returned pointer.

functions.name: CPLStringList::StealList
functions.description: Transfers ownership of the internal char** list to the caller and clears the object.
requirements: Caller becomes responsible for freeing the returned list with CSLDestroy().
After call, the CPLStringList no longer holds the list.

functions.name: CPLStringList::Sort
functions.description: Sorts the list (likely lexicographically) and marks it as sorted. Returns reference to self.
requirements: Sorting criteria are implementation-defined.

functions.name: CPLStringList::IsSorted
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the list is currently sorted.
requirements: None.

functions.name: cpl::starts_with

functions.name: cpl::starts_with

functions.description: Returns true if str starts with the std::string prefix.
requirements: str must provide size() and compare().

functions.name: cpl::starts_with
functions.signature: template <class StringType> inline bool cpl::starts_with(const StringType &str, std::string_view prefix);

requirements: str must provide size() and compare().

functions.name: cpl::ends_with
functions.signature: template <class StringType> inline bool cpl::ends_with(const StringType &str, const char *suffix);
functions.description: Returns true if str ends with the C-string suffix.
requirements: str must provide size() and compare().
suffix must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: cpl::ends_with
functions.signature: template <class StringType> inline bool cpl::ends_with(const StringType &str, const std::string &suffix);
functions.description: Returns true if str ends with the std::string suffix.
requirements: str must provide size() and compare().

functions.name: cpl::ends_with
functions.signature: template <class StringType> inline bool cpl::ends_with(const StringType &str, std::string_view suffix);
functions.description: Returns true if str ends with the std::string_view suffix.
requirements: str must provide size() and compare().

functions.name: cpl::CSLIterator::operator*
functions.description: Dereferences the iterator to return the current const char* element.
requirements: Iterator must be valid and not at end.

functions.name: cpl::CSLIterator::operator++
functions.description: Pre-increment: advances the iterator to the next element and returns reference to self.

functions.name: cpl::CSLIterator::operator==

functions.name: cpl::CSLIteratorWrapper::begin
functions.description: Returns an iterator to the first element of the wrapped CSLConstList.

functions.name: cpl::CSLIteratorWrapper::end
functions.description: Returns an iterator representing the end of the wrapped list.
requirements: Use with begin() for range-based for.

functions.name: cpl::Iterate
functions.description: Wraps a CSLConstList into an iterator-enabled wrapper for range-based for loops.
requirements: papszList is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).

functions.name: cpl::Iterate
functions.description: Creates an iterator wrapper over a CPLStringList.
requirements: aosList is a valid list object.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIterator::operator*
functions.description: Dereferences to a (name, value) pair parsed from the current list entry. Value may be the original string if not name=value depending on wrapper setting.
requirements: Iterator must be valid; next increment invalidates previously returned pair.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIterator::operator++
functions.description: Pre-increment: advances to the next list entry and returns reference to self.
requirements: Iterator must not already be past-the-end.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIterator::operator==
functions.description: Compares two name/value iterators for equality.
requirements: Both iterators should iterate over the same underlying list.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIterator::operator!=
functions.description: Returns true if iterators are not equal.
requirements: Both iterators should iterate over the same underlying list.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIteratorWrapper::begin
functions.description: Returns an iterator pointing to the first entry to iterate as (name, value) pairs.
requirements: Underlying list may be NULL; behavior is consistent with empty iteration.

functions.name: cpl::CSLNameValueIteratorWrapper::end
functions.description: Returns an end iterator for (name, value) iteration.
requirements: Use with begin() for range-based for.

functions.name: cpl::IterateNameValue
functions.signature: inline cpl::CSLNameValueIteratorWrapper cpl::IterateNameValue(CSLConstList papszList, bool bReturnNullKeyIfNotNameValue = false);
functions.description: Wraps a CSLConstList to iterate over (name, value) pairs. If bReturnNullKeyIfNotNameValue is true, non name=value entries yield (nullptr, string).
requirements: papszList is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).

functions.name: cpl::IterateNameValue
functions.signature: inline cpl::CSLNameValueIteratorWrapper cpl::IterateNameValue(const CPLStringList &aosList, bool bReturnNullKeyIfNotNameValue = false);
functions.description: Creates a (name, value) iterator wrapper over a CPLStringList.
requirements: aosList is a valid list object.

functions.name: cpl::ToVector
functions.description: Converts a CSLConstList into a std::vector<std::string>.
requirements: papszList is a NULL-terminated list (may be NULL).

functions.name: GDALGetDataTypeSize
functions.description: Deprecated helper returning the size in bits of the given GDALDataType. Prefer GDALGetDataTypeSizeBits() (or GDALGetDataTypeSizeBytes()*8).
requirements: eDataType must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALGetDataTypeSizeBits
functions.description: Returns the number of bits for the provided GDALDataType.
requirements: eDataType must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALGetDataTypeSizeBytes
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes for the provided GDALDataType.
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALDataTypeIsComplex
functions.description: Indicates whether the given GDALDataType is a complex (real+imag) type.
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALDataTypeIsInteger
functions.description: Indicates whether the GDALDataType is an integer type (signed or unsigned).
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALDataTypeIsFloating
functions.description: Indicates whether the GDALDataType is a floating point type (Float16/32/64 or complex float).
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALDataTypeIsSigned
functions.description: Indicates whether the GDALDataType is signed (for integer types).
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALGetDataTypeName
functions.description: Returns a constant string name for the provided GDALDataType (e.g., "UInt16", "Float32").
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value
Returned pointer is owned by GDAL; do not free or modify

functions.name: GDALGetDataTypeByName
functions.description: Returns the GDALDataType matching a type name string, or GDT_Unknown if unrecognized.
requirements: pszName must be a valid, null-terminated C string

functions.name: GDALDataTypeUnion
functions.description: Returns a GDALDataType that can represent values from both input types (a common supertype).
requirements: Both arguments must be valid GDALDataType values

functions.name: GDALDataTypeUnionWithValue
functions.signature: GDALDataType CPL_STDCALL GDALDataTypeUnionWithValue(GDALDataType eDT, double dValue, int bComplex)
functions.description: Returns a GDALDataType that can represent both eDT and the provided value dValue. bComplex indicates whether complex types are allowed.
requirements: eDT must be a valid GDALDataType
bComplex is treated as boolean (0/!=0)

functions.name: GDALFindDataType
functions.signature: GDALDataType CPL_STDCALL GDALFindDataType(int nBits, int bSigned, int bFloating, int bComplex)
functions.description: Finds the smallest GDALDataType matching bit width, signedness, floating/integer, and complexness constraints.
requirements: nBits should be a positive integer representing desired bit depth
bSigned, bFloating, bComplex are boolean-like (0/!=0) flags

functions.name: GDALFindDataTypeForValue
functions.signature: GDALDataType CPL_STDCALL GDALFindDataTypeForValue(double dValue, int bComplex)
functions.description: Returns a GDALDataType that can represent the given scalar value (and complex if bComplex).
requirements: bComplex is boolean-like (0/!=0)

functions.name: GDALAdjustValueToDataType
functions.signature: double GDALAdjustValueToDataType(GDALDataType eDT, double dfValue, int *pbClamped, int *pbRounded)
functions.description: Adjusts dfValue to fit into the range/precision of eDT, signaling via pbClamped and pbRounded if clamping or rounding occurred. Returns the adjusted value.
requirements: eDT must be a valid GDALDataType
pbClamped may be NULL or must point to writable int if provided
pbRounded may be NULL or must point to writable int if provided

functions.name: GDALIsValueExactAs
functions.description: Checks if dfValue can be represented exactly by eDT without rounding.
requirements: eDT must be a valid GDALDataType

functions.name: GDALIsValueInRangeOf
functions.description: Checks if dfValue is within the numeric range of eDT (ignoring exactness).
requirements: eDT must be a valid GDALDataType

functions.name: GDALGetNonComplexDataType
functions.description: Returns the non-complex counterpart of a complex type, or the input type if already non-complex.
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALDataType enumeration value

functions.name: GDALDataTypeIsConversionLossy
functions.description: Indicates whether converting from eTypeFrom to eTypeTo may lose information (precision/range).
requirements: eTypeFrom and eTypeTo must be valid GDALDataType values

functions.name: GDALGetAsyncStatusTypeName
functions.description: Returns the string name of a GDALAsyncStatusType value.
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALAsyncStatusType
Returned pointer is owned by GDAL; do not free or modify

functions.name: GDALGetAsyncStatusTypeByName
functions.description: Parses a status type name into a GDALAsyncStatusType value, or GARIO_TypeCount/unknown if not recognized.
requirements: pszName must be a valid, null-terminated C string

functions.name: GDALGetColorInterpretationName
functions.description: Returns the string name for a GDALColorInterp value (e.g., "Red", "Alpha", "NIR").
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALColorInterp value
Returned pointer is owned by GDAL; do not free or modify

functions.name: GDALGetColorInterpretationByName
functions.description: Parses a color interpretation name into a GDALColorInterp enumeration value.
requirements: pszName must be a valid, null-terminated C string

functions.name: GDALGetPaletteInterpretationName
functions.description: Returns the string name for a GDALPaletteInterp value (e.g., "RGB", "Gray").
requirements: Argument must be a valid GDALPaletteInterp value
Returned pointer is owned by GDAL; do not free or modify

functions.name: GDALAllRegister
functions.description: Registers all available GDAL drivers (raster/vector/others) into the driver manager.
requirements: Must be called once before opening/creating datasets if automatic registration is desired
Thread-safety of repeated calls is driver-manager dependent; typical usage is single early call

functions.name: GDALRegisterPlugins
functions.description: Loads and registers GDAL plugins (if any) according to the build/runtime configuration.
requirements: Should be called after GDALAllRegister() to ensure core is initialized (common practice)

functions.name: GDALRegisterPlugin
functions.description: Registers a single plugin by name. Returns CE_None on success or an error code.
requirements: name must be a valid, null-terminated C string identifying a known plugin

functions.name: GDALCreate
functions.signature: GDALDatasetH CPL_STDCALL GDALCreate(GDALDriverH hDriver, const char *pszName, int nXSize, int nYSize, int nBands, GDALDataType eType, CSLConstList papszOptions)
functions.description: Creates a new raster dataset using the specified driver, filename, raster size, band count, data type, and creation options. Returns a dataset handle or NULL on failure.
requirements: hDriver must be a valid GDALDriverH supporting Create()
pszName must be a valid, null-terminated C string path/identifier acceptable by the driver
nXSize and nYSize should be positive (driver-specific minimums may apply)
nBands should be >= 0 (driver-specific constraints may apply)
eType must be a valid GDALDataType supported by the driver
papszOptions may be NULL or a null-terminated string list of key=value options

functions.name: GDALCreateCopy
functions.signature: GDALDatasetH CPL_STDCALL GDALCreateCopy(GDALDriverH, const char *, GDALDatasetH, int, CSLConstList, GDALProgressFunc, void *)
functions.description: Creates a new dataset by copying from an existing source dataset using the specified driver. Supports options and progress callback. Returns a dataset handle or NULL on failure.
requirements: Driver handle must support CreateCopy() or Create()+generic copy
Destination name (const char *) must be a valid, null-terminated C string
Source dataset handle must be valid and open
bStrict (int) semantics are driver-dependent (non-zero to enforce strict adherence in typical GDAL API)
papszOptions may be NULL or a null-terminated string list
pfnProgress may be NULL; if non-NULL, pProgressData is passed back to it

functions.name: GDALIdentifyDriver
functions.signature: GDALDriverH CPL_STDCALL GDALIdentifyDriver(const char *pszFilename, CSLConstList papszFileList)
functions.description: Heuristically identifies the most suitable driver to open the given filename, optionally using a sibling file list. Returns the driver handle or NULL if none matches.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated C string
papszFileList may be NULL or a null-terminated array of sibling filenames

functions.name: GDALIdentifyDriverEx
functions.signature: GDALDriverH CPL_STDCALL GDALIdentifyDriverEx(const char *pszFilename, unsigned int nIdentifyFlags, const char *const *papszAllowedDrivers, const char *const *papszFileList)
functions.description: Extended driver identification with flags, optional whitelist of allowed drivers, and sibling files. Returns the driver handle or NULL if none matches.
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid, null-terminated C string
nIdentifyFlags is a bitmask defined by GDAL; use 0 if unsure
papszAllowedDrivers may be NULL or a null-terminated array of driver names to restrict search
papszFileList may be NULL or a null-terminated array of sibling filenames

functions.name: GDALOpen
functions.description: Opens a dataset by filename for read-only or update access, returning an opaque GDALDataset handle on success, or NULL on failure. Typical usage: call GDALOpen with GA_ReadOnly or GA_Update, and close the returned handle with GDALClose() when done.
requirements: pszFilename must point to a valid, null-terminated path or dataset name understood by a registered driver.
eAccess must be GA_ReadOnly or GA_Update.
On success, the returned GDALDatasetH must be later closed with GDALClose().
Thread safety and reentrancy depend on the opened driver; no guarantee is stated here.

functions.name: GDALOpenShared
functions.description: Opens a dataset in shared mode so that multiple callers opening the same resource can share a single underlying handle. Returns a GDALDataset handle on success, or NULL on failure. Close with GDALClose().
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid dataset path or name.
eAccess must be GA_ReadOnly or GA_Update.
Returned handle must be closed with GDALClose().
Sharing semantics depend on driver support; behavior is undefined if the driver does not support shared mode.

functions.name: GDALOpenEx
functions.signature: GDALDatasetH GDALOpenEx(const char *pszFilename, unsigned int nOpenFlags, const char *const *papszAllowedDrivers, const char *const *papszOpenOptions, const char *const *papszSiblingFiles);
functions.description: Extended open entry point allowing flags, driver allow-lists, open options, and sibling file hints. Returns a GDALDataset handle on success or NULL on failure. Use when you need to constrain driver selection or pass driver-specific options. Close with GDALClose().
requirements: pszFilename must be a valid dataset path or name.

nOpenFlags is a bitmask of GDAL_OF_* flags. Notable constraints: GDAL_OF_THREAD_SAFE is not compatible with GDAL_OF_VECTOR, GDAL_OF_MULTIDIM_RASTER or GDAL_OF_UPDATE; GDAL_OF_INTERNAL cannot be used with GDAL_OF_SHARED; GDAL_OF_DEFAULT_BLOCK_ACCESS / GDAL_OF_ARRAY_BLOCK_ACCESS / GDAL_OF_HASHSET_BLOCK_ACCESS are mutually exclusive.
papszAllowedDrivers may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of driver names to restrict to.
papszOpenOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of key=value strings understood by the targeted driver(s).
papszSiblingFiles may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of sibling filenames (hints for identification).
On success, the dataset must be closed with GDALClose().

functions.name: GDALDumpOpenDatasets
functions.description: Writes a report of currently open GDAL datasets to the given FILE stream. Useful for debugging open-handle leaks.
requirements: The FILE* must be a valid, open stream for writing (e.g., stdout, stderr, or a file opened in write/append mode).

functions.name: GDALGetDriverByName
functions.description: Finds a registered driver by its short name and returns a driver handle, or NULL if not found.
requirements: Argument must be a null-terminated driver short name (e.g., "GTiff").
Returned handle is owned by the GDAL driver manager; do not destroy it. Valid as long as GDAL driver manager exists.

functions.name: GDALGetDriverCount
functions.description: Returns the number of registered GDAL drivers.

functions.name: GDALGetDriver
functions.description: Returns the driver handle at the specified index in the registered driver list, or NULL if the index is out of range.
requirements: Index must be in the range [0, GDALGetDriverCount()-1].
Returned handle is owned by GDAL; do not destroy it.

functions.name: GDALCreateDriver
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new (unregistered) GDAL driver object. Intended for driver implementers prior to registration with GDALRegisterDriver().
requirements: The returned GDALDriverH must be either registered with GDALRegisterDriver() or destroyed with GDALDestroyDriver() to avoid leaks.
Caller is responsible for initializing driver metadata and function pointers before registration.

functions.name: GDALDestroyDriver
functions.description: Destroys an unregistered driver object previously created with GDALCreateDriver(). Do not use on drivers owned by the driver manager.
requirements: Handle must refer to a driver allocated with GDALCreateDriver() and not registered.
Must not be called on handles returned by GDALGetDriverByName()/GDALGetDriver().

functions.name: GDALRegisterDriver
functions.description: Registers a driver with the global driver manager, making it available for open/create operations.
requirements: Handle must be a valid driver object prepared for registration (metadata, create/open callbacks, etc.).
Do not destroy the driver directly after registration; it becomes owned by the driver manager.

functions.name: GDALDeregisterDriver
functions.description: Unregisters a driver from the global driver manager.
requirements: Handle must be a driver currently registered with the driver manager.
Any datasets opened by this driver should be closed before deregistration to avoid undefined behavior.

functions.name: GDALDestroyDriverManager
functions.description: Destroys the global GDAL driver manager and unregisters all drivers. Typically called at process shutdown.
requirements: Should only be called when no datasets are open and no driver handles are in use.
Subsequent driver queries require re-registration (e.g., GDALAllRegister()).

functions.name: GDALDestroy
functions.description: Cleans up GDAL global state. Typically used at process shutdown to free internal resources.
requirements: Should be called when no GDAL objects (datasets, bands, drivers) are in use.
Calling more than once is safe but unnecessary; details unspecified.

functions.name: GDALDeleteDataset
functions.description: Asks the specified driver to delete the dataset at the given filename/path.
requirements: hDriver must be a valid driver that can delete the given dataset.
pszFilename must be a valid path identifying a dataset instance for that driver.
Check the returned CPLErr for success/failure.

functions.name: GDALRenameDataset
functions.signature: CPLErr GDALRenameDataset(GDALDriverH hDriver, const char *pszNewName, const char *pszOldName);
functions.description: Requests the driver to rename/move a dataset from old name to new name. Note the parameter order is (newName, oldName).
requirements: hDriver must support renaming for the targeted dataset.
pszOldName and pszNewName must be valid, null-terminated paths.
Callers must check the returned CPLErr for success.

functions.name: GDALCopyDatasetFiles
functions.signature: CPLErr GDALCopyDatasetFiles(GDALDriverH hDriver, const char *pszNewName, const char *pszOldName);
functions.description: Requests the driver to copy a dataset (all its files) from old name to new name.
requirements: hDriver must support copying/cloning for the dataset.
pszOldName and pszNewName must be valid paths.
Check CPLErr return value and handle any errors.

functions.name: GDALValidateCreationOptions
functions.description: Validates a list of creation options against the capabilities of a driver. Returns non-zero if options are valid, zero otherwise.
requirements: hDriver must be a valid driver handle.
papszCreationOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated string list of key=value pairs.

functions.name: GDALGetOutputDriversForDatasetName
functions.signature: char **GDALGetOutputDriversForDatasetName(const char *pszDestFilename, int nFlagRasterVector, bool bSingleMatch, bool bEmitWarning);
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated string list of driver short names suitable for writing to the given destination filename. Helps select the right output driver(s).
requirements: pszDestFilename must be the intended output file name (used for extension-based matching).
nFlagRasterVector selects raster/vector: use values consistent with raster/vector expectations (per GDAL docs).
If bSingleMatch is true, list may contain at most one driver.
If bEmitWarning is true, the function may emit warnings on ambiguous or unknown extensions.
The returned list must be freed by the caller (inferred GDAL convention) with CSLDestroy().

functions.name: GDALDriverHasOpenOption
functions.description: Checks whether a driver advertises support for the specified open option.
requirements: hDriver must be a valid registered driver handle.
pszOpenOptionName must be a non-NULL, null-terminated option name string.

functions.name: GDALGetDriverShortName
functions.description: Returns the short name (identifier) of the driver. Deprecated API; prefer querying driver metadata directly when possible.
requirements: Argument must be a valid driver handle.
Returned pointer is owned by GDAL; do not free.

functions.name: GDALGetDriverLongName
functions.description: Returns the long (human-readable) name of the driver. Deprecated API.
requirements: Argument must be a valid driver handle.
Returned string is owned by GDAL; do not free.

functions.name: GDALGetDriverHelpTopic
functions.description: Returns a help topic path/URL for the driver. Deprecated API.
requirements: Argument must be a valid driver handle.
Returned string is owned by GDAL; do not free.

functions.name: GDALGetDriverCreationOptionList
functions.description: Returns an XML snippet describing the driver's creation options. Deprecated API; prefer reading GDAL_DMD_CREATIONOPTIONLIST metadata.
requirements: Argument must be a valid driver handle.
Returned string is owned by GDAL; do not free.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::IsInit
functions.description: Reports whether the envelope has been initialized (i.e., is non-empty). Implementation checks MinX against +infinity to detect an uninitialized/empty envelope. Use before accessing dimensions like Width/Height.
requirements: May be called on any OGREnvelope instance.
No side effects; does not modify the object.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Merge
functions.description: Expands this envelope to include the union of itself with another 2D envelope.
requirements: sOther must be a valid OGREnvelope object (can be default-constructed; union will handle uninitialized/empty).
Modifies the current object in-place.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Intersect
functions.description: Replaces this envelope by its intersection with another envelope. If there is no intersection, the envelope becomes empty (default-constructed state).
requirements: sOther must be a valid OGREnvelope object.
Modifies the current object in-place.
On no-overlap, the object is reset to an empty envelope.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Intersects
functions.description: Tests whether this envelope intersects the other envelope (inclusive of touching at edges). Returns non-zero if they intersect, zero otherwise.
requirements: Can be called regardless of initialization; comparison uses member values as-is.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Contains
functions.description: Tests whether this envelope fully contains the other envelope (inclusive boundaries). Returns non-zero if contained, zero otherwise.
requirements: Can be called regardless of initialization; comparison uses member values as-is.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Width
functions.description: Returns the width (MaxX - MinX) of the envelope. Envelope must be initialized.
requirements: Caller must ensure the envelope is initialized (IsInit() != 0) before calling.
Behavior is undefined for uninitialized/empty envelopes.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Height
functions.description: Returns the height (MaxY - MinY) of the envelope. Envelope must be initialized.
requirements: Caller must ensure the envelope is initialized (IsInit() != 0) before calling.
Behavior is undefined for uninitialized/empty envelopes.

functions.name: OGREnvelope::Center
functions.description: Computes the center point of the envelope and writes it to dfX and dfY. Envelope must be initialized.
requirements: Caller must ensure the envelope is initialized (IsInit() != 0) before calling.
dfX and dfY must be valid lvalue references (writable).

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::Is3D
functions.description: Reports whether both MinZ and MaxZ are valid (finite) numbers, i.e., the envelope has meaningful Z extents.
requirements: No side effects; does not modify the object.

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::IsInit
functions.description: Reports whether the 3D envelope has been initialized (i.e., non-empty in 2D sense). Uses same test as OGREnvelope: MinX != +infinity.
requirements: May be called on any OGREnvelope3D instance.
No side effects; does not modify the object.

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::Merge
functions.description: Expands this 3D envelope to include the union of itself with another 3D envelope (updates X, Y, and Z extents).
requirements: sOther must be a valid OGREnvelope3D object.
Modifies the current object in-place.

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::Intersect
functions.description: Replaces this 3D envelope by its intersection with another 3D envelope. If there is no intersection, the envelope becomes empty (default-constructed state).
requirements: sOther must be a valid OGREnvelope3D object.
Modifies the current object in-place.
On no-overlap, the object is reset to an empty 3D envelope.

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::Intersects
functions.description: Tests whether this 3D envelope intersects the other 3D envelope (inclusive). Returns non-zero if they intersect, zero otherwise.
requirements: Can be called regardless of initialization; comparison uses member values as-is.

functions.name: OGREnvelope3D::Contains
functions.description: Tests whether this 3D envelope fully contains the other 3D envelope (inclusive boundaries). Returns non-zero if contained, zero otherwise.
requirements: Can be called regardless of initialization; comparison uses member values as-is.

functions.name: OGRGeometryTypeToName
functions.description: Returns a human-readable name for the given OGR geometry type. Useful for logging, UIs, or diagnostics.
requirements: eType must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value; unknown values may map to a generic/unknown name (exact mapping not specified here).
Returned pointer is owned by the library; treat as read-only.

functions.name: OGRMergeGeometryTypes
functions.description: Returns a geometry type that can represent both input types, promoting dimensions and collections as needed. Intended to merge schema/feature types.
requirements: eMain and eExtra are OGRwkbGeometryType values; behavior for invalid values is unspecified.
Result type depends on library rules; exact promotion behavior not documented here.

functions.name: OGRMergeGeometryTypesEx
functions.signature: OGRwkbGeometryType OGRMergeGeometryTypesEx(OGRwkbGeometryType eMain, OGRwkbGeometryType eExtra, int bAllowPromotingToCurves)
functions.description: Extended merge of geometry types with control on whether curve types can be produced.
requirements: eMain and eExtra must be OGRwkbGeometryType values.
bAllowPromotingToCurves: non-zero to allow curve promotion, zero to forbid.
Result type depends on library rules; exact promotion behavior not documented here.

functions.name: OGR_GT_Flatten
functions.description: Returns the 2D (flattened) geometry type corresponding to eType (strips Z/M).
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value; behavior for invalid values is unspecified.

functions.name: OGR_GT_SetZ
functions.description: Returns the 3D (Z-enabled) geometry type corresponding to eType.
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value representing a base type; behavior for invalid values is unspecified.

functions.name: OGR_GT_SetM
functions.description: Returns the measured (M-enabled) geometry type corresponding to eType.
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value representing a base type; behavior for invalid values is unspecified.

functions.name: OGR_GT_SetModifier
functions.signature: OGRwkbGeometryType OGR_GT_SetModifier(OGRwkbGeometryType eType, int bSetZ, int bSetM)
functions.description: Returns a geometry type derived from eType with Z and/or M dimensions set according to bSetZ and bSetM.
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value representing a base type.
bSetZ and bSetM are boolean-like integers: non-zero to enable, zero to disable the corresponding dimension.

functions.name: OGR_GT_HasZ
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the geometry type has a Z (3D) dimension; zero otherwise.
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value.

functions.name: OGR_GT_HasM
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the geometry type has an M (measure) dimension; zero otherwise.
requirements: eType must be an OGRwkbGeometryType value.

functions.name: OGR_GT_IsSubClassOf
functions.description: Returns non-zero if eType is a subclass of eSuperType within the OGR geometry type hierarchy (e.g., LineString is a Curve).
requirements: eType and eSuperType must be valid OGRwkbGeometryType values.

functions.name: OGR_GT_IsCurve
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the given geometry type is a Curve (or subclass), zero otherwise.
requirements: Argument must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value.

functions.name: OGR_GT_IsSurface
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the given geometry type is a Surface (or subclass), zero otherwise.
requirements: Argument must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value.

functions.name: OGR_GT_IsNonLinear
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the given geometry type is non-linear (e.g., circular arcs), zero otherwise.
requirements: Argument must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value.

functions.name: OGR_GT_GetCollection
functions.description: Returns the collection type (e.g., MultiLineString for LineString) associated with eType.
requirements: eType must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value; behavior for base/abstract or invalid types is unspecified.

functions.name: OGR_GT_GetSingle
functions.description: Returns the single (non-collection) geometry type corresponding to a collection type (e.g., LineString for MultiLineString).
requirements: eType must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value; behavior for non-collection types is unspecified.

functions.name: OGR_GT_GetCurve
functions.description: Returns the curved equivalent of a linear base type when one exists (e.g., LineString -> CompoundCurve).
requirements: eType must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value; mapping rules are library-defined and not detailed here.

functions.name: OGR_GT_GetLinear
functions.description: Returns the linearized equivalent of a curved geometry type when one exists (e.g., CompoundCurve -> LineString).
requirements: eType must be a valid OGRwkbGeometryType value; mapping rules are library-defined and not detailed here.

functions.name: OGR_GET_MS
functions.description: Returns the number of milliseconds extracted from a decimal seconds value (e.g., 1.234s -> 234 ms). Intended for handling OGR date/time seconds with millisecond precision.
requirements: fSec is a floating point seconds value; valid range/rounding behavior is not specified in this header (unknown).

functions.name: OGRParseDate
functions.signature: int OGRParseDate(const char *pszInput, OGRField *psOutput, int nOptions)
functions.description: Parses a date/time string into an OGRField::Date structure. Supports an option flag OGRPARSEDATE_OPTION_LAX for more permissive parsing. Returns an integer status (likely non-zero on success).
requirements: pszInput must be a valid NUL-terminated string representing a date/time.
psOutput must be a valid, writable pointer to an OGRField; on success, its Date member will be populated.

Exact accepted formats and return code conventions are not detailed in this header (some behavior unknown).

functions.name: GDALVersionInfo
functions.description: Returns version/build information about the GDAL library as a string. Typical inputs include keys identifying which information to return (e.g., version, release name), but exact accepted keys are not specified here.
requirements: Argument must be a valid NUL-terminated string key; supported keys are not documented in this header (unknown).
Returned pointer is owned by the library; treat as read-only.

functions.name: GDALCheckVersion
functions.signature: int CPL_STDCALL GDALCheckVersion(int nVersionMajor, int nVersionMinor, const char *pszCallingComponentName)
functions.description: Checks at runtime that the GDAL library version matches the expected major.minor version. Intended to ensure plugins or callers run against a compatible GDAL. If pszCallingComponentName is not NULL and versions mismatch, the function will emit a failure mentioning the component name. Returns TRUE if the version matches, otherwise FALSE.

pszCallingComponentName may be NULL or a non-NULL component name for error reporting.
Caller should check the return value and abort or handle incompatibility on FALSE.

functions.name: OGRGetGEOSVersion
functions.description: Query the version of the GEOS library available to OGR. Returns true if GEOS is available and version numbers could be retrieved, and false otherwise. Callers typically pass addresses of three ints to receive major/minor/patch values.
requirements: Call only after GDAL/OGR is initialized (e.g., OGRRegisterAll) if your environment requires it; exact initialization requirements are unknown.
It is unknown whether any of pnMajor, pnMinor, pnPatch may be NULL. To be safe, pass non-null pointers if you need the values.
Check the boolean return value before using any output values.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionCreate
functions.description: Create a new coordinate precision descriptor handle used to store XY/Z/M resolutions and per-format options.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionDestroy

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionGetXYResolution
functions.description: Get the XY (planar) resolution stored in the given coordinate precision descriptor.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
Returned value may be OGR_GEOM_COORD_PRECISION_UNKNOWN (0) if not defined.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionGetZResolution

requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
Returned value may be OGR_GEOM_COORD_PRECISION_UNKNOWN (0) if not defined.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionGetMResolution
functions.description: Get the M (measure) resolution stored in the coordinate precision descriptor.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
Returned value may be OGR_GEOM_COORD_PRECISION_UNKNOWN (0) if not defined.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionGetFormats
functions.description: Retrieve the list of format names that have format-specific options defined in this coordinate precision descriptor. Likely returned as a string list.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
Ownership/ lifetime and freeing convention for the returned char ** is unknown from this header; consult implementation/docs before freeing or reusing beyond the descriptor lifetime.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionGetFormatSpecificOptions
functions.description: Get the format-specific options associated with a given format name in this coordinate precision descriptor. Returned as a constant string list (CSLConstList).
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
pszFormatName must point to a valid, null-terminated C string naming the format.
Returned list is const; do not modify or free it.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionSet
functions.signature: void OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionSet(OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH, double dfXYResolution, double dfZResolution, double dfMResolution);
functions.description: Set the XY/Z/M resolutions into a coordinate precision descriptor. These are typically grid sizes or tolerances used by drivers/operations.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
dfXYResolution, dfZResolution, dfMResolution should be non-negative; exact allowed ranges are not documented here.

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionSetFromMeter
functions.signature: void OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionSetFromMeter(OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH, OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfXYMeterResolution, double dfZMeterResolution, double dfMResolution);
functions.description: Set the coordinate precision resolutions from meter-based values given a spatial reference. XY and Z resolutions in meters are converted to native units according to the provided SRS.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
hSRS should be a valid spatial reference handle describing the coordinate system; behavior is unknown if NULL.
dfXYMeterResolution and dfZMeterResolution are in meters; dfMResolution is unitless or application-specific (not documented here).

functions.name: OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionSetFormatSpecificOptions
functions.description: Associate format-specific options with a given format name in the coordinate precision descriptor. Options are provided as a string list.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeomCoordinatePrecisionH.
pszFormatName must be a non-null C string naming the format.
papszOptions must be a NULL-terminated list of strings or NULL; exact expected keys/values depend on the target format and are undocumented here.

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateFromWkb
functions.signature: OGRErr OGR_G_CreateFromWkb(const void * /*pabyData*/, OGRSpatialReferenceH /*hSRS*/, OGRGeometryH * /*phGeometry*/, int /*nSize*/);
functions.description: Create an OGRGeometry from a WKB (Well-Known Binary) buffer. Optionally supply a spatial reference. Returns an error code and, on success, stores the created geometry handle in phGeometry.
requirements: pabyData must point to at least nSize bytes of WKB data.
phGeometry must be a non-null pointer to receive the created geometry handle on success.

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateFromWkbEx
functions.signature: OGRErr OGR_G_CreateFromWkbEx(const void * /*pabyData*/, OGRSpatialReferenceH /*hSRS*/, OGRGeometryH * /*phGeometry*/, size_t /*nSize*/);

requirements: pabyData must point to at least nSize bytes of WKB data.
phGeometry must be non-null to receive the handle.
Check the OGRErr return value before using output.
Destroy the created geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateFromWkt
functions.description: Create an OGRGeometry from a WKT (Well-Known Text) string. The input may be updated/advanced during parsing (typical OGR convention). Returns an error code and, on success, a geometry handle.
requirements: ppszInput must be a non-null pointer to a C string pointer referencing a valid, null-terminated WKT. It may be advanced/modified by the parser (common OGR behavior).
phGeometry must be non-null to receive the handle.
hSRS may be NULL or valid; exact requirement not documented here.
Check OGRErr and destroy the geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry() on success.

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateFromFgf
functions.signature: OGRErr OGR_G_CreateFromFgf(const void * /*pabyData*/, OGRSpatialReferenceH /*hSRS*/, OGRGeometryH * /*phGeometry*/, int /*nBytes*/, int * /*pnBytesConsumed*/);
functions.description: Create an OGRGeometry from an FGF (FDO Geometry Format) buffer. Optionally returns the number of bytes consumed. Returns an OGRErr and sets the output geometry handle on success.
requirements: pabyData must point to at least nBytes bytes of FGF data.
phGeometry must be non-null to receive the created geometry.
pnBytesConsumed may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive the number of consumed bytes; exact optionality is not documented.
Check OGRErr and destroy the created geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry() on success.

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateFromEnvelope
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_CreateFromEnvelope(double /*dfMinX*/, double /*dfMinY*/, double /*dfMaxX*/, double /*dfMaxY*/, OGRSpatialReferenceH /*hSRS*/);
functions.description: Create an axis-aligned rectangular polygon (or equivalent geometry) from an envelope defined by min/max X and Y. Optionally assign a spatial reference.
requirements: dfMinX <= dfMaxX and dfMinY <= dfMaxY are expected; behavior for invalid envelopes is not documented.
hSRS may be NULL or valid; exact requirement not documented here.
Caller must destroy the returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_DestroyGeometry
functions.description: Destroy and free an OGRGeometry handle.
requirements: Pass a valid OGRGeometryH previously created by OGR/GEOS functions.
Do not use the geometry handle after destruction.
Safe to pass NULL is unknown from this header.

functions.name: OGR_G_CreateGeometry
functions.description: Instantiate a new, empty geometry of the specified OGRwkbGeometryType (e.g., wkbPoint, wkbLineString).
requirements: Pass a valid OGRwkbGeometryType enumeration value.

functions.name: OGR_G_ApproximateArcAngles
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_ApproximateArcAngles(double dfCenterX, double dfCenterY, double dfZ, double dfPrimaryRadius, double dfSecondaryAxis, double dfRotation, double dfStartAngle, double dfEndAngle, double dfMaxAngleStepSizeDegrees);
functions.description: Approximate a circular/elliptical arc into a linearized geometry using angle-stepped interpolation. Returns a line string or curve-approximated geometry.
requirements: dfPrimaryRadius and dfSecondaryAxis should be positive; exact constraints are not documented.
Angles are in degrees; rotation is the ellipse rotation in degrees.
Caller must destroy the returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_ForceToPolygon
functions.description: Attempt to convert the input geometry to a Polygon, coercing multi/curve types if possible. Returns a new geometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_ForceToLineString
functions.description: Attempt to convert the input geometry to a LineString, linearizing curves as needed. Returns a new geometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_ForceToMultiPolygon
functions.description: Attempt to convert the input geometry to a MultiPolygon. Returns a new geometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_RemoveLowerDimensionSubGeoms

functions.name: OGR_G_GetDimension

functions.name: OGR_G_GetCoordinateDimension

functions.name: OGR_G_SetCoordinateDimension
functions.description: Set the coordinate dimension (e.g., 2D vs 3D/Measured) of the geometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_Is3D

functions.name: OGR_G_IsMeasured

functions.name: OGRwkbExportOptionsCreate

functions.name: OGRwkbExportOptionsDestroy

functions.name: OGRwkbExportOptionsSetVariant
