functions.name: OGR_G_Overlaps
functions.description: Return non-zero if the two geometries overlap (interiors intersect but neither contains the other).
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.

functions.name: OGR_G_Boundary
functions.description: Return the boundary of the geometry as a new geometry (e.g., a polygon's ring(s)).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_ConvexHull
functions.description: Return the convex hull of the geometry as a new geometry.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_ConcaveHull
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_ConcaveHull(OGRGeometryH, double dfRatio, bool bAllowHoles);
functions.description: Compute a concave hull of the input geometry, controlled by a ratio parameter and whether holes are allowed.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
dfRatio should be in (0,1]; exact accepted range is not documented here.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Buffer
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_Buffer(OGRGeometryH, double dfDist, int nQuadSegs);
functions.description: Compute a buffer around the geometry at distance dfDist, approximating curves with nQuadSegs segments per quarter circle.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
nQuadSegs should be a positive integer; exact constraints are not documented.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_BufferEx
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_BufferEx(OGRGeometryH, double dfDist, CSLConstList papszOptions);
functions.description: Compute a buffer around the geometry with options controlling buffering behavior.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
papszOptions is a const string list or NULL; supported options are not documented.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Intersection
functions.description: Return the geometric intersection of two geometries.
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Union
functions.description: Return the geometric union of two geometries.
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_UnionCascaded
functions.description: Compute a cascaded union of a geometry collection (more efficient for many polygons).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle (typically multi/polygonal collection).
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_UnaryUnion
functions.description: Compute the unary union (merge) of parts of a single geometry/collection.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_PointOnSurface
functions.description: Return a point geometry guaranteed to lie on the surface of the input (for areal geometries) where possible.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Difference
functions.description: Return the difference of two geometries (A minus B).
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_SymDifference
functions.description: Return the symmetric difference of two geometries.
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Distance
functions.description: Compute the Cartesian distance between two geometries.
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.

functions.name: OGR_G_Distance3D
functions.description: Compute the 3D distance between two geometries, considering Z where available.
requirements: Pass two valid geometry handles.

functions.name: OGR_G_Length
functions.description: Compute the length of a linear geometry in its coordinate units.
requirements: Pass a valid linear geometry handle; for non-linear/areal types length semantics may be zero or undefined.

functions.name: OGR_G_GeodesicLength
functions.description: Compute a geodesic length along the geometry using spherical/ellipsoidal calculations where supported.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Assumes geometry coordinates are in geographic SRS; exact assumptions are not documented.

functions.name: OGR_G_Area
functions.description: Compute the area of a polygonal geometry in its coordinate units.
requirements: Pass a valid areal geometry handle; for non-areal types area may be zero.

functions.name: OGR_G_GeodesicArea
functions.description: Compute the geodesic area of a polygonal geometry on the ellipsoid/sphere.
requirements: Pass a valid areal geometry handle.
Assumes geographic SRS; exact model not documented.

functions.name: OGR_G_IsClockwise
functions.description: Return true if a ring geometry has clockwise orientation.
requirements: Pass a valid ring/linestring geometry; behavior on other types is not documented.

functions.name: OGR_G_Centroid
functions.description: Compute the centroid of the input geometry and store it into the provided point geometry handle. Returns non-zero on success.
requirements: Pass a valid source geometry handle.
Destination geometry handle must be a valid, mutable point geometry; exact preconditions are not documented.
Check the return int before using the result.

functions.name: OGR_G_Value
functions.description: For linear geometries, return a point located at the given distance along the geometry (similar to line interpolation).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle (typically linear).
dfDistance is in geometry units; valid range relative to geometry length is not documented.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Empty
functions.description: Set a geometry to the empty state, removing all points/subgeometries.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Operation mutates the geometry in place.

functions.name: OGR_G_IsEmpty
functions.description: Return non-zero if the geometry is empty.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.

functions.name: OGR_G_IsValid
functions.description: Check if the geometry is valid according to OGC/GEOS rules. Returns non-zero if valid.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.

functions.name: OGR_G_MakeValid
functions.description: Return a valid representation of the input geometry, attempting to fix invalidities.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_MakeValidEx
functions.description: Like OGR_G_MakeValid but with options controlling the operation.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Options list is const or NULL; supported options are not documented.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Normalize
functions.description: Return a normalized version of the geometry (consistent vertex/ring ordering, etc.).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_IsSimple
functions.description: Return non-zero if the geometry is simple (no self-intersections, etc.).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.

functions.name: OGR_G_IsRing
functions.description: Return non-zero if the geometry is a ring (closed and simple).
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle (typically LineString).

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPrecision
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH OGR_G_SetPrecision(OGRGeometryH, double dfGridSize, int nFlags);
functions.description: Snap geometry coordinates to a precision grid of size dfGridSize, with optional flags controlling topology handling.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle.
dfGridSize should be positive; exact constraints are not documented.
nFlags may include OGR_GEOS_PREC_NO_TOPO and OGR_GEOS_PREC_KEEP_COLLAPSED.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_Polygonize
functions.description: Build polygons from linework contained in the input geometry.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle containing suitable linework.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_BuildArea
functions.description: Build areal geometry (polygons) from input linework, closing and forming rings as needed.
requirements: Pass a valid geometry handle of linear type containing edges.
Destroy returned geometry with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry().

functions.name: OGR_G_GetPointCount
functions.description: Returns the number of vertex points in a point/line/ring-like geometry.
requirements: hGeom must be a valid OGRGeometryH handle that supports vertices (e.g., Point/LineString/LinearRing).
Behavior for non-vertex geometries is implementation-defined; expect 0 or relevant count.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetPoints
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_G_GetPoints(OGRGeometryH hGeom, void *pabyX, int nXStride, void *pabyY, int nYStride, void *pabyZ, int nZStride);
functions.description: Bulk-reads vertex coordinates into user-provided buffers with specified byte strides.
requirements: hGeom must be a valid geometry with vertices.
pabyX and pabyY must be non-null if nXStride/nYStride are used to write X/Y values.
If Z values are desired, pabyZ must be non-null; otherwise pass NULL and/or 0 stride.
Strides must be positive and large enough for writing the element type (typically sizeof(double)) as arranged by caller.
Buffers must be large enough to hold all points according to count and stride.
Returns the number of points written.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetPointsZM
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_G_GetPointsZM(OGRGeometryH hGeom, void *pabyX, int nXStride, void *pabyY, int nYStride, void *pabyZ, int nZStride, void *pabyM, int nMStride);
functions.description: Bulk-reads vertex X/Y/Z/M coordinates with independent output buffers and strides.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have vertices.
pabyX and pabyY must be non-null to retrieve X/Y.
pabyZ and/or pabyM may be NULL if not needed.
Each non-null buffer must have a positive stride and enough space.
Returns the number of points written.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetX
functions.description: Returns the X coordinate of the i-th point of a vertex-based geometry.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (i+1) points.
i must be in [0, point_count-1].

functions.name: OGR_G_GetY
functions.description: Returns the Y coordinate of the i-th point of a vertex-based geometry.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (i+1) points.
i must be in [0, point_count-1].

functions.name: OGR_G_GetZ
functions.description: Returns the Z coordinate of the i-th point; for 2D geometries may return 0 or undefined value per implementation.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (i+1) points.
i must be in [0, point_count-1].
Geometry should be 3D to have meaningful Z.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetM
functions.description: Returns the M (measure) value of the i-th point; for non-measured geometries may return 0 or undefined value per implementation.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (i+1) points.
i must be in [0, point_count-1].
Geometry should be measured (has M) for meaningful values.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetPoint
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_GetPoint(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double *, double *, double *);
functions.description: Retrieves X, Y, Z of the specified point into caller-provided double pointers.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (iPoint+1) points.
Output pointers for X and Y must be non-null; Z pointer may be NULL if not needed.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetPointZM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_GetPointZM(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double *, double *, double *, double *);
functions.description: Retrieves X, Y, Z, M of the specified point into caller-provided pointers.
requirements: hGeom must be valid and have at least (iPoint+1) points.
X and Y pointers must be non-null; Z/M pointers may be NULL if not needed.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPointCount
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPointCount(OGRGeometryH hGeom, int nNewPointCount);
functions.description: Resizes the number of vertices in a point/line/ring geometry; newly added points get defaulted values.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry that supports vertex editing.
nNewPointCount must be >= 0.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPoint
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPoint(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double, double, double);
functions.description: Sets X, Y, Z of an existing point at index iPoint.
requirements: hGeom must be modifiable and have at least (iPoint+1) points (set size first if needed).
iPoint must be within current point count.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPoint_2D
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPoint_2D(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double, double);
functions.description: Sets the 2D coordinates (X, Y) of an existing point; Z left unchanged or default.
requirements: hGeom must be modifiable and have at least (iPoint+1) points.
iPoint must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPointM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPointM(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double, double, double);
functions.description: Sets X, Y, and M (measure) of an existing point.
requirements: hGeom must be modifiable and have at least (iPoint+1) points.
iPoint must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPointZM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPointZM(OGRGeometryH, int iPoint, double, double, double, double);
functions.description: Sets X, Y, Z, M of an existing point.
requirements: hGeom must be modifiable and have at least (iPoint+1) points.
iPoint must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_G_AddPoint
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_AddPoint(OGRGeometryH, double, double, double);
functions.description: Appends a new point with X, Y, Z at the end of a geometry supporting vertices.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry type that supports adding points (e.g., LineString, LinearRing).

functions.name: OGR_G_AddPoint_2D
functions.description: Appends a new 2D point (X, Y); Z may default to 0/undefined.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry type that supports adding points.

functions.name: OGR_G_AddPointM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_AddPointM(OGRGeometryH, double, double, double);
functions.description: Appends a new point with X, Y, M (measure).
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry type that supports adding points.

functions.name: OGR_G_AddPointZM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_AddPointZM(OGRGeometryH, double, double, double, double);
functions.description: Appends a new point with X, Y, Z, M.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry type that supports adding points.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPoints
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPoints(OGRGeometryH hGeom, int nPointsIn, const void *pabyX, int nXStride, const void *pabyY, int nYStride, const void *pabyZ, int nZStride);
functions.description: Sets all vertex coordinates from caller-provided X/Y/(optional Z) arrays with per-array byte stride.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable vertex-based geometry.
nPointsIn >= 0.
pabyX and pabyY must be non-null and point to at least nPointsIn elements with the specified strides.
If Z is to be set, pabyZ must be non-null and have sufficient space; else pass NULL.
Strides must be positive and appropriate for the element layout provided by the caller.

functions.name: OGR_G_SetPointsZM
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_G_SetPointsZM(OGRGeometryH hGeom, int nPointsIn, const void *pabyX, int nXStride, const void *pabyY, int nYStride, const void *pabyZ, int nZStride, const void *pabyM, int nMStride);
functions.description: Sets all vertex coordinates, including optional Z and M, from strided input arrays.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable vertex-based geometry.
nPointsIn >= 0.
pabyX and pabyY must be non-null; pabyZ/pabyM may be NULL if not set.
Each provided array must have positive stride and enough data for nPointsIn elements.

functions.name: OGR_G_SwapXY
functions.description: Swaps X and Y coordinates in-place for all points of a geometry.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable geometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetGeometryCount
functions.description: Returns the number of sub-geometries in a geometry collection, or rings in polygon, etc.
requirements: hGeom must be a valid geometry handle.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetGeometryRef
functions.description: Returns a handle to the i-th sub-geometry of a composite geometry (non-owning reference).
requirements: hGeom must be valid and contain at least (i+1) sub-geometries.
i must be in range [0, count-1].
Returned handle is a borrowed reference; do not destroy it.

functions.name: OGR_G_AddGeometry
functions.description: Adds a copy of the provided geometry as a child of a geometry collection or compatible container.
requirements: Container hGeom must be a modifiable type that can hold sub-geometries (e.g., GeometryCollection, Multi* or Polygon for rings).
hNewGeom must be a valid geometry; it will be copied (caller retains ownership).
Check OGRErr return value for success.

functions.name: OGR_G_AddGeometryDirectly
functions.description: Adds the provided geometry as a child without copying; container takes ownership.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable collection/container geometry.
hNewGeom must be a valid geometry; ownership is transferred on success—caller must not use/destroy it after success.
Check OGRErr return value.

functions.name: OGR_G_RemoveGeometry
functions.description: Removes a sub-geometry by index; optionally destroys it.
requirements: hGeom must be a modifiable container geometry with at least (iGeom+1) children.
iGeom index must be valid.
The bDelete flag (third int) controls whether the removed geometry is destroyed; set appropriately.
Check OGRErr return value.

functions.name: OGR_G_HasCurveGeometry
functions.description: Tests whether a geometry or its sub-geometries contain curve (non-linear) components.
requirements: hGeom must be valid.
bLookForNonLinear non-zero may request explicit detection of any non-linear components.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetLinearGeometry
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH CPL_DLL OGR_G_GetLinearGeometry(OGRGeometryH hGeom, double dfMaxAngleStepSizeDegrees, char **papszOptions);
functions.description: Returns a linearized approximation of a curve geometry, using angle step tolerance and options; caller owns result.
requirements: hGeom must be valid; curve components will be approximated.
dfMaxAngleStepSizeDegrees controls densification; non-negative recommended.
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list of name=value options.
Returned geometry must be destroyed by caller with OGR_G_DestroyGeometry.

functions.name: OGR_G_GetCurveGeometry
functions.description: Returns a curve representation of a linear geometry when possible; caller owns result.
requirements: hGeom must be valid.
papszOptions may be NULL or a string list.
Caller must destroy returned geometry.

functions.name: OGRBuildPolygonFromEdges
functions.signature: OGRGeometryH CPL_DLL OGRBuildPolygonFromEdges(OGRGeometryH hLinesAsCollection, int bBestEffort, int bAutoClose, double dfTolerance, OGRErr *peErr);
functions.description: Builds polygons from a collection of linework edges; returns polygonal geometry on success.
requirements: hLinesAsCollection must be a valid geometry collection of lineal components.
bBestEffort/bAutoClose control behavior; non-zero to enable respective modes.
dfTolerance is a snapping/closure tolerance; non-negative recommended.
peErr may be non-null to receive operation status.
Caller owns returned geometry and must destroy it.

functions.name: OGRSetGenerate_DB2_V72_BYTE_ORDER
functions.description: Enables or disables generation of DB2 V7.2 byte order in WKB I/O (compatibility flag).
requirements: Pass 0 to disable, non-zero to enable.
Check OGRErr return value.

functions.name: OGRGetGenerate_DB2_V72_BYTE_ORDER
functions.description: Returns whether DB2 V7.2 byte order generation is enabled.

functions.name: OGRSetNonLinearGeometriesEnabledFlag
functions.description: Globally enables/disables use of non-linear (curve) geometries.
requirements: bFlag: 0 to disable, non-zero to enable.
Affects subsequent geometry operations/creation in the process.

functions.name: OGRGetNonLinearGeometriesEnabledFlag
functions.description: Returns current global flag for non-linear geometry support.

functions.name: OGRHasPreparedGeometrySupport
functions.description: Indicates if prepared geometry operations are supported in the build/runtime (e.g., via GEOS).

functions.name: OGRCreatePreparedGeometry
functions.description: Creates a prepared-geometry object for repeated spatial predicates; accelerates operations with a fixed geometry.
requirements: hGeom must be a valid geometry supported by the prepared geometry backend.
Returned handle must be destroyed with OGRDestroyPreparedGeometry.

functions.name: OGRDestroyPreparedGeometry
functions.description: Destroys a prepared-geometry object created with OGRCreatePreparedGeometry.
requirements: hPreparedGeom must be a valid prepared geometry handle or NULL.

functions.name: OGRPreparedGeometryIntersects
functions.description: Tests intersection between a prepared geometry and another geometry.
requirements: hPreparedGeom must be a valid prepared handle.
hOtherGeom must be a valid geometry.
Return is non-zero for true, zero for false; exact semantics per backend.

functions.name: OGRPreparedGeometryContains
functions.description: Tests containment between a prepared geometry and another geometry.
requirements: hPreparedGeom must be valid.
hOtherGeom must be valid.
Non-zero for true, zero for false.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_Create
functions.description: Creates a new field definition with a name and type; caller owns handle.
requirements: pszName must be a valid C-string (non-null).
eType must be a valid OGRFieldType.
Destroy with OGR_Fld_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_Destroy
functions.description: Destroys a field definition created by OGR_Fld_Create.
requirements: Handle must be from OGR_Fld_Create or equivalent and not used after destroy.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetName
functions.description: Sets the field definition name.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
pszName must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetNameRef
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal name string of a field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by the field definition; do not free or modify.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetAlternativeName
functions.description: Sets an alternative/human-readable name for the field, if supported.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
pszName must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetAlternativeNameRef
functions.description: Gets the alternative name of the field (internal pointer).
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Do not free or modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetType
functions.description: Gets the main type of the field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetType
functions.description: Sets the main type of the field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Type must be a valid OGRFieldType.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetSubType
functions.description: Gets the subtype of the field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetSubType
functions.description: Sets the subtype of the field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Subtype must be a valid OGRFieldSubType.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetJustify
functions.description: Gets the justification for string fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetJustify
functions.description: Sets the justification for string fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetWidth
functions.description: Gets the defined width (field size) of the field.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetWidth
functions.description: Sets the field width (size).
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Width should be >= 0.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetPrecision
functions.description: Gets the numeric precision for numeric fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetPrecision
functions.description: Sets the numeric precision for numeric fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Precision should be >= 0.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetTZFlag
functions.description: Gets the time zone flag for date/time fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetTZFlag
functions.description: Sets the time zone flag for date/time fields.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_Set
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_Fld_Set(OGRFieldDefnH, const char *, OGRFieldType, int, int, OGRJustification);
functions.description: Convenience to set multiple attributes (name, type, width, precision, justification) on a field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Name must be a non-null C-string.
Width and precision should be >= 0.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_IsIgnored
functions.description: Returns whether the field is marked as ignored.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetIgnored
functions.description: Marks the field as ignored or not.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_IsNullable
functions.description: Returns whether the field allows NULL values.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetNullable
functions.description: Sets the nullability of the field.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetGenerated
functions.description: Marks a field as generated (computed) or not.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_IsGenerated
functions.description: Checks if a field is marked as generated.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_IsUnique
functions.description: Returns whether a field is marked as unique.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetUnique
functions.description: Sets whether a field must be unique.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetDefault
functions.description: Gets the default value expression/string for the field (internal pointer).
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetDefault
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_Fld_SetDefault(OGRFieldDefnH hDefn, const char *);
functions.description: Sets the default value expression/string for the field.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
String must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_IsDefaultDriverSpecific
functions.description: Indicates if the default is driver-specific.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetDomainName
functions.description: Gets the name of the associated field domain (internal pointer).
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetDomainName
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_Fld_SetDomainName(OGRFieldDefnH hDefn, const char *);
functions.description: Sets the name of the associated field domain.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
pszName must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_GetComment
functions.description: Gets an optional comment/description (internal pointer).
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_Fld_SetComment
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_Fld_SetComment(OGRFieldDefnH hDefn, const char *);
functions.description: Sets an optional comment/description on the field definition.
requirements: hDefn must be valid.
pszComment must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_GetFieldTypeName
functions.description: Returns the canonical name of an OGRFieldType.

functions.name: OGR_GetFieldTypeByName
functions.description: Parses a field type name to its OGRFieldType enum.
requirements: pszName must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_GetFieldSubTypeName
functions.description: Returns the canonical name of an OGRFieldSubType.

functions.name: OGR_GetFieldSubTypeByName
functions.description: Parses a subtype name to its OGRFieldSubType value.
requirements: pszName must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: OGR_AreTypeSubTypeCompatible
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_AreTypeSubTypeCompatible(OGRFieldType eType, OGRFieldSubType eSubType);

functions.description: Gets the merge policy for the domain.
requirements: Handle must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_FldDomain_SetMergePolicy
functions.description: Sets the merge policy for the domain.
requirements: Handle must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_CodedFldDomain_Create
functions.signature: OGRFieldDomainH CPL_DLL OGR_CodedFldDomain_Create(const char *pszName, const char *pszDescription, OGRFieldType eFieldType, OGRFieldSubType eFieldSubType, const OGRCodedValue *enumeration);
functions.description: Creates a coded value field domain with a set of allowed values; caller owns handle.
requirements: pszName must be non-null; eFieldType/SubType must be valid.
enumeration must point to a valid list of coded values terminated as per API (termination details unknown here).
Destroy with OGR_FldDomain_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_CodedFldDomain_GetEnumeration
functions.description: Gets the enumeration of coded values for a coded domain (internal pointer).
requirements: Domain must be a coded value domain.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_RangeFldDomain_Create
functions.signature: OGRFieldDomainH CPL_DLL OGR_RangeFldDomain_Create(const char *pszName, const char *pszDescription, OGRFieldType eFieldType, OGRFieldSubType eFieldSubType, const OGRField *psMin, bool bMinIsInclusive, const OGRField *psMax, bool bMaxIsInclusive);
functions.description: Creates a range field domain with optional inclusive/exclusive min/max bounds; caller owns handle.
requirements: pszName must be non-null; types must be valid.
psMin/psMax may be NULL for unbounded sides; if non-null they must match the field type/subtype.
Destroy with OGR_FldDomain_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_RangeFldDomain_GetMin
functions.description: Gets the minimum bound and whether it is inclusive (via out param).
requirements: Domain must be valid and be a range domain.
pbIsInclusiveOut may be NULL if not needed.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_RangeFldDomain_GetMax
functions.description: Gets the maximum bound and whether it is inclusive (via out param).
requirements: Domain must be valid and be a range domain.
pbIsInclusiveOut may be NULL.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_GlobFldDomain_Create
functions.signature: OGRFieldDomainH CPL_DLL OGR_GlobFldDomain_Create(const char *pszName, const char *pszDescription, OGRFieldType eFieldType, OGRFieldSubType eFieldSubType, const char *pszGlob);
functions.description: Creates a glob/regex-like field domain restricting values by a glob pattern; caller owns handle.
requirements: pszName and pszGlob must be non-null.
Types must be valid.
Destroy with OGR_FldDomain_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_GlobFldDomain_GetGlob
functions.description: Gets the glob pattern string of a glob domain.
requirements: Domain must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetName
functions.description: Gets the layer name (internal string).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetGeomType
functions.description: Gets the default/declared geometry type for the layer.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetGeometryTypes
functions.signature: OGRGeometryTypeCounter CPL_DLL *OGR_L_GetGeometryTypes(OGRLayerH hLayer, int iGeomField, int nFlags, int *pnEntryCount, GDALProgressFunc pfnProgress, void *pProgressData);
functions.description: Computes geometry type distribution for a layer/geometry field; returns an array of counters and count via out param.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField is the geometry field index (usually 0).
nFlags may include OGR_GGT_* bit flags.
pnEntryCount must be non-null to receive number of entries.
pfnProgress may be NULL or a valid GDALProgressFunc; pProgressData passed to it.
Caller must free the returned array with CPLFree.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetSpatialFilter
functions.description: Gets the current spatial filter geometry (borrowed, may be NULL).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not destroy returned geometry.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetSpatialFilter
functions.description: Sets the spatial filter geometry for the default geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and modifiable/read state manageable.
hGeom may be NULL to clear, or a valid geometry; ownership is not transferred (copied/borrowed per driver).

functions.name: OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterRect
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterRect(OGRLayerH, double, double, double, double);
functions.description: Sets a rectangular spatial filter (minX, minY, maxX, maxY) on the default geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Coordinates must define a rectangle (min <= max).

functions.name: OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterEx
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterEx(OGRLayerH, int iGeomField, OGRGeometryH hGeom);
functions.description: Sets the spatial filter geometry for a specific geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField must be a valid geometry field index.
hGeom may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterRectEx
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_L_SetSpatialFilterRectEx(OGRLayerH, int iGeomField, double dfMinX, double dfMinY, double dfMaxX, double dfMaxY);
functions.description: Sets a rectangular spatial filter on a specific geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField must be valid.
Coordinates must define a rectangle (min <= max).

functions.name: OGR_L_SetAttributeFilter
functions.description: Sets the SQL-like attribute filter expression for the layer.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
pszFilter may be NULL to clear or a valid expression string.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_ResetReading
functions.description: Resets the layer's sequential reading cursor to the beginning.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetNextFeature
functions.description: Fetches the next feature matching current filters; returns NULL at end or on failure. Caller owns returned feature and must destroy it.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Caller must destroy the returned feature with OGR_F_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetArrowStream
functions.signature: bool CPL_DLL OGR_L_GetArrowStream(OGRLayerH hLayer, struct ArrowArrayStream *out_stream, char **papszOptions);
functions.description: Exports the layer as an Arrow C stream for columnar reading.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
out_stream must be non-null and point to an ArrowArrayStream to be initialized; caller must release per Arrow C Data Interface rules.
papszOptions may be NULL or a NULL-terminated list.

functions.name: OGR_L_IsArrowSchemaSupported
functions.signature: bool CPL_DLL OGR_L_IsArrowSchemaSupported(OGRLayerH hLayer, const struct ArrowSchema *schema, char **papszOptions, char **ppszErrorMsg);
functions.description: Checks if a given Arrow C schema is supported for write operations by the layer/driver.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
schema must be a valid ArrowSchema pointer.
papszOptions may be NULL.
ppszErrorMsg may be non-null to receive an allocated error message (caller must free with CPLFree).

functions.name: OGR_L_CreateFieldFromArrowSchema
functions.signature: bool CPL_DLL OGR_L_CreateFieldFromArrowSchema(OGRLayerH hLayer, const struct ArrowSchema *schema, char **papszOptions);
functions.description: Creates a new field in the layer based on an Arrow C schema.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support schema changes.
schema must be valid and compatible.
papszOptions may be NULL.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: OGR_L_WriteArrowBatch
functions.signature: bool CPL_DLL OGR_L_WriteArrowBatch(OGRLayerH hLayer, const struct ArrowSchema *schema, struct ArrowArray *array, char **papszOptions);
functions.description: Writes a batch of records to the layer using Arrow C data structures.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support writes.
schema and array must be valid and mutually consistent.
papszOptions may be NULL.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetNextByIndex
functions.description: Sets the sequential read cursor to the feature at the given index (if supported).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Index must be >= 0 and within supported range.
Check OGRErr; not all drivers support random read.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetFeature
functions.description: Fetches a feature by FID; returns NULL if not found. Caller owns the returned feature.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
FID must be valid in layer context.
Caller must destroy returned feature.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetFeature
functions.description: Updates an existing feature in the layer (by FID).
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support update.
hFeat must be valid and typically have a valid FID.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_CreateFeature
functions.description: Creates a new feature in the layer.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support create.
hFeat must be valid and match layer schema.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_DeleteFeature
functions.description: Deletes a feature by FID.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support delete.
FID must exist or OGRErr indicates failure.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_UpsertFeature
functions.description: Inserts or updates a feature depending on whether the FID exists (if supported).
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support upsert.
hFeat must be valid and compliant with schema.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_UpdateFeature
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_UpdateFeature(OGRLayerH, OGRFeatureH, int nUpdatedFieldsCount, const int *panUpdatedFieldsIdx, int nUpdatedGeomFieldsCount, const int *panUpdatedGeomFieldsIdx, bool bUpdateStyleString) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Updates only selected fields/geometries of a feature by index lists; optionally updates style string.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support partial update.
hFeat must be valid (FID typically required).
If nUpdatedFieldsCount>0, panUpdatedFieldsIdx must be a valid array of indices.
If nUpdatedGeomFieldsCount>0, panUpdatedGeomFieldsIdx must be valid.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetLayerDefn
functions.description: Gets the layer's feature definition (borrowed).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not destroy returned handle.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetSpatialRef
functions.description: Gets the layer's spatial reference (borrowed).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not destroy returned SRS.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetSupportedSRSList
functions.signature: OGRSpatialReferenceH CPL_DLL *OGR_L_GetSupportedSRSList(OGRLayerH hLayer, int iGeomField, int *pnCount);
functions.description: Returns an array of supported spatial references for a geometry field and its count.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField must be valid index.
pnCount must be non-null to receive count.
Caller likely must free the returned array and possibly referenced SRS handles depending on API (ownership unclear from header).

functions.name: OGR_L_SetActiveSRS
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_SetActiveSRS(OGRLayerH hLayer, int iGeomField, OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS);
functions.description: Sets the active spatial reference for a layer geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support this operation.
iGeomField must be valid.
hSRS must be a valid SRS or NULL per driver capabilities.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_FindFieldIndex
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_L_FindFieldIndex(OGRLayerH, const char *, int bExactMatch);
functions.description: Finds the index of a field by name with exact or approximate matching.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
pszName must be non-null.
bExactMatch non-zero for exact matching.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetFeatureCount
functions.description: Returns the number of features, optionally applying force computation flag.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Second parameter is a boolean-like flag (e.g., force or fast path selector; exact meaning depends on driver).

functions.name: OGR_L_GetExtent
functions.description: Gets the 2D extent (minx, maxx, miny, maxy) of the default geometry field into OGREnvelope.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
psExtent must be non-null.
bForce flag controls whether to scan if not cached.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetExtentEx
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_GetExtentEx(OGRLayerH, int iGeomField, OGREnvelope *psExtent, int bForce);
functions.description: Gets the 2D extent of a specific geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField must be valid index.
psExtent must be non-null.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetExtent3D
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_GetExtent3D(OGRLayerH hLayer, int iGeomField, OGREnvelope3D *psExtent3D, int bForce);
functions.description: Gets the 3D extent (X,Y,Z) of a geometry field.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
iGeomField must be valid.
psExtent3D must be non-null.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_TestCapability
functions.description: Tests whether the layer supports a named capability.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
pszCap must be non-null capability string constant.

functions.name: OGR_L_CreateField
functions.description: Creates a new attribute field in the layer schema.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support schema modification.
hFieldDefn must be valid.
Third int is a boolean-like flag (e.g., approx OK).
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_CreateGeomField
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_CreateGeomField(OGRLayerH hLayer, OGRGeomFieldDefnH hFieldDefn, int bForce);
functions.description: Creates a new geometry field in the layer schema.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support adding geometry fields.
hFieldDefn must be valid.
bForce non-zero to force creation if supported.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_DeleteField
functions.description: Deletes an attribute field from the layer schema.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support deletion.
iField must be a valid index.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_ReorderFields
functions.description: Reorders the layer's attribute fields according to the provided map.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support reordering.
panMap must be a valid array of size equal to current field count.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_ReorderField
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_ReorderField(OGRLayerH, int iOldFieldPos, int iNewFieldPos);
functions.description: Moves a single attribute field from old to new position.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support reordering.
Indices must be valid.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_AlterFieldDefn
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_AlterFieldDefn(OGRLayerH, int iField, OGRFieldDefnH hNewFieldDefn, int nFlags);
functions.description: Alters properties of an attribute field according to flags.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support alter field.
iField must be valid.
hNewFieldDefn must be valid.
nFlags controls which properties to alter.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_AlterGeomFieldDefn
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_AlterGeomFieldDefn(OGRLayerH, int iField, OGRGeomFieldDefnH hNewGeomFieldDefn, int nFlags);
functions.description: Alters properties of a geometry field according to flags.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support alter geom field.
iField must be valid.
hNewGeomFieldDefn must be valid.
nFlags controls behavior.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_StartTransaction
functions.description: Starts a transaction on the layer if supported.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support transactions.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_CommitTransaction
functions.description: Commits an ongoing transaction on the layer.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and in a transaction.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_RollbackTransaction
functions.description: Rolls back an ongoing transaction on the layer.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and in a transaction.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Rename
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Rename(OGRLayerH hLayer, const char *pszNewName);
functions.description: Renames the layer to a new name.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and support rename.
pszNewName must be non-null.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_SyncToDisk
functions.description: Flushes pending changes of the layer to disk.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetFeaturesRead
functions.description: Returns the count of features read so far from this layer (diagnostic).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetFIDColumn
functions.description: Gets the name of the FID column, if applicable.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetGeometryColumn
functions.description: Gets the name of the default geometry column, if applicable.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_L_GetStyleTable
functions.description: Gets the layer's style table (borrowed).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
Do not destroy returned table.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetStyleTableDirectly
functions.description: Sets the layer's style table taking ownership.
requirements: hLayer must be valid and modifiable.
hStyleTable may be NULL or valid; ownership transfers.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetStyleTable
functions.description: Sets the layer's style table without ownership transfer (copy/borrow per driver).
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
hStyleTable may be NULL or valid.

functions.name: OGR_L_SetIgnoredFields
functions.description: Sets a list of field names to ignore during IO.
requirements: hLayer must be valid.
List must be NULL-terminated array of C-strings or NULL to clear.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Intersection
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Intersection(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Performs layer-on-layer spatial intersection, writing results to output layer.
requirements: All layer handles must be valid; destination layer must be writable and schema compatible.
papszOptions may be NULL or list.
Progress function may be NULL; pProgressData passed through.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Union
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Union(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Performs spatial union of two layers into an output layer.
requirements: Input/output layers must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_SymDifference
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_SymDifference(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Performs symmetric difference of two layers into an output layer.
requirements: Inputs/outputs must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Identity
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Identity(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Computes identity overlay (A with attributes from B) into output layer.
requirements: Layers must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Update
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Update(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Performs update overlay operation into output layer.
requirements: Layers must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Clip
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Clip(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Clips one layer by another into output layer.
requirements: Layers must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_L_Erase
functions.signature: OGRErr CPL_DLL OGR_L_Erase(OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, OGRLayerH, char **, GDALProgressFunc, void *);
functions.description: Erases features of the first layer by the second into output layer.
requirements: Layers must be valid; output writable.
Options/progress as above.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_DS_Destroy
functions.description: Destroys a data source handle, closing it and releasing resources.
requirements: Handle must be valid and not used after destroy.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetName
functions.description: Gets the name of the data source (internal string).
requirements: hDS must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetLayerCount
functions.description: Returns the number of layers in the data source.
requirements: hDS must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetLayer
functions.description: Gets a handle to the i-th layer (borrowed).
requirements: hDS must be valid.
i must be in [0, layer_count-1].
Do not destroy returned handle.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetLayerByName
functions.description: Gets a handle to a layer by name (borrowed) or NULL if not found.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
pszName must be non-null.

functions.name: OGR_DS_DeleteLayer
functions.description: Deletes a layer by index from the data source.
requirements: hDS must be valid and support deletion.
Index must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetDriver
functions.description: Gets the driver handle used to open/create this data source (borrowed).

functions.signature: OGRLayerH CPL_DLL OGR_DS_CreateLayer(OGRDataSourceH, const char *, OGRSpatialReferenceH, OGRwkbGeometryType, char **);
functions.description: Creates a new layer in the data source with specified name, SRS, geometry type, and options; returns new layer handle.
requirements: hDS must be valid and support create layer.
pszName must be non-null.
hSRS may be NULL or valid.
eType valid geometry type.
papszOptions may be NULL.
Returned layer is owned by data source; do not destroy.

functions.name: OGR_DS_CopyLayer
functions.signature: OGRLayerH CPL_DLL OGR_DS_CopyLayer(OGRDataSourceH, OGRLayerH, const char *, char **);
functions.description: Copies an existing layer into the data source under a new name with options.
requirements: hDS must be valid and support copy.
hSrcLayer must be valid.
pszNewName must be non-null.
papszOptions may be NULL.
Returned layer is owned by data source.

functions.name: OGR_DS_TestCapability
functions.description: Tests whether the data source supports a named capability.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
pszCap must be non-null.

functions.name: OGR_DS_ExecuteSQL
functions.signature: OGRLayerH CPL_DLL OGR_DS_ExecuteSQL(OGRDataSourceH, const char *, OGRGeometryH, const char *);
functions.description: Executes an SQL statement with optional spatial filter and dialect; returns a result layer or NULL.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
pszStatement must be non-null.
hSpatialFilter may be NULL or valid geometry.
pszDialect may be NULL.

functions.name: OGR_DS_ReleaseResultSet
functions.description: Releases a result layer obtained from ExecuteSQL.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
hLayer must be a result set returned by this data source.

functions.name: OGR_DS_Reference
functions.description: Increments data source reference count; returns new count.
requirements: hDS must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_DS_Dereference
functions.description: Decrements data source reference count; may close when reaching zero; returns new count.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
Do not use after final dereference.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetRefCount
functions.description: Gets current data source reference count.
requirements: hDS must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetSummaryRefCount
functions.description: Gets a summary reference count (including aggregate references).
requirements: hDS must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_DS_SyncToDisk
functions.description: Flushes pending changes on the data source to disk.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGR_DS_GetStyleTable
functions.description: Gets the data source style table (borrowed).
requirements: hDS must be valid.
Do not destroy returned table.

functions.name: OGR_DS_SetStyleTableDirectly
functions.description: Sets the data source style table taking ownership.
requirements: hDS must be valid and modifiable.
hStyleTable may be NULL or valid; ownership transfers.

functions.name: OGR_DS_SetStyleTable
functions.description: Sets the data source style table without ownership transfer.
requirements: hDS must be valid.
hStyleTable may be NULL or valid.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_GetName
functions.description: Gets the driver name (internal string).
requirements: hDriver must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_Open
functions.signature: OGRDataSourceH CPL_DLL OGR_Dr_Open(OGRSFDriverH, const char *, int) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Opens a datasource with the specified driver and update flag; returns handle or NULL.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_TestCapability
functions.description: Tests whether the driver supports a named capability.
requirements: hDriver must be valid.
pszCap must be non-null.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_CreateDataSource
functions.signature: OGRDataSourceH CPL_DLL OGR_Dr_CreateDataSource(OGRSFDriverH, const char *, char **) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Creates a new data source using the driver with options; returns handle or NULL.
requirements: hDriver must be valid and support create.
pszName must be non-null.
papszOptions may be NULL or list.
Caller must destroy returned data source with OGR_DS_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_CopyDataSource
functions.signature: OGRDataSourceH CPL_DLL OGR_Dr_CopyDataSource(OGRSFDriverH, OGRDataSourceH, const char *, char **) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Copies an existing data source with a new name and options.
requirements: hDriver must be valid and support copy.
hSrcDS must be valid.
pszNewName must be non-null.
papszOptions may be NULL.
Caller must destroy returned data source.

functions.name: OGR_Dr_DeleteDataSource
functions.description: Deletes a data source by name/path using the driver.
requirements: hDriver must be valid and support deletion.
pszName must be non-null.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGROpen
functions.signature: OGRDataSourceH CPL_DLL OGROpen(const char *, int, OGRSFDriverH *) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Opens a data source for read-only or update using the driver manager; optionally returns the selected driver.
requirements: pszFilename must be non-null.
