pahDriver may be NULL or a pointer to receive driver handle.
Caller must destroy returned data source with OGR_DS_Destroy.

functions.name: OGROpenShared
functions.signature: OGRDataSourceH CPL_DLL OGROpenShared(const char *, int, OGRSFDriverH *) CPL_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT;
functions.description: Opens a shared (reference-counted) data source via the driver manager.
requirements: Same as OGROpen; returned DS participates in shared list.
Caller must still call OGRReleaseDataSource or OGR_DS_Destroy per API.

functions.name: OGRReleaseDataSource
functions.description: Releases a reference to a shared-opened data source.
requirements: hDS must be a valid shared-open data source.
Check OGRErr.

functions.name: OGRRegisterDriver
functions.description: Registers a driver with the driver manager.
requirements: hDriver must be valid.
Typically called during initialization; do not register duplicates.

functions.name: OGRDeregisterDriver
functions.description: Deregisters a driver from the driver manager.
requirements: hDriver must be valid and previously registered.

functions.name: OGRGetDriverCount
functions.description: Returns the number of registered OGR drivers.

functions.name: OGRGetDriver
functions.description: Gets the i-th registered driver.
requirements: i must be in [0, count-1].
Returned handle is borrowed; do not destroy.

functions.name: OGRGetDriverByName
functions.description: Finds a registered driver by name.
requirements: pszName must be non-null.
Borrowed handle; do not destroy.

functions.name: OGRGetOpenDSCount
functions.description: Returns the number of currently open data sources (managed by driver manager).

functions.name: OGRGetOpenDS
functions.description: Gets the i-th open data source from the driver manager (borrowed).
requirements: iDS must be in [0, OGRGetOpenDSCount()-1].
Do not destroy returned handle.

functions.name: OGRRegisterAll
functions.description: Registers all available drivers (both vector and raster via GDAL).
requirements: Call once at process start typically; safe to call multiple times.

functions.name: OGRCleanupAll
functions.description: Cleans up all drivers and releases global resources.
requirements: Call when shutting down GDAL/OGR in a process that requires explicit cleanup.
After this, most OGR/GDAL operations are invalid until re-initialization.

functions.name: OGR_SM_Create
functions.description: Creates a style manager optionally bound to a style table; caller owns handle.
requirements: hStyleTable may be NULL or a valid style table.
Destroy manager with OGR_SM_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_SM_Destroy
functions.description: Destroys a style manager.
requirements: hSM must be valid and not used after destroy.

functions.name: OGR_SM_InitFromFeature
functions.signature: const char CPL_DLL *OGR_SM_InitFromFeature(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, OGRFeatureH hFeat);
functions.description: Initializes the style manager from a feature's style string and returns it (internal pointer).
requirements: hSM and hFeat must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_SM_InitStyleString
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_SM_InitStyleString(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, const char *pszStyleString);
functions.description: Initializes the style manager from a style string; returns non-zero on success.
requirements: hSM must be valid.
pszStyleString must be non-null.

functions.name: OGR_SM_GetPartCount
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_SM_GetPartCount(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, const char *pszStyleString);
functions.description: Returns the number of style parts in the current or provided style string.
requirements: hSM must be valid.
pszStyleString may be NULL to use the manager state or non-null style string.

functions.name: OGR_SM_GetPart
functions.signature: OGRStyleToolH CPL_DLL OGR_SM_GetPart(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, int nPartId, const char *pszStyleString);
functions.description: Gets a style tool representing the nth part of the current/provided style string.
requirements: hSM must be valid.
nPartId must be in range.
pszStyleString may be NULL or non-null.
Returned tool should be destroyed with OGR_ST_Destroy when no longer needed (ownership per API; likely caller owns).

functions.name: OGR_SM_AddPart
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_SM_AddPart(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, OGRStyleToolH hST);
functions.description: Adds a style tool as a part to the current style definition.
requirements: hSM must be valid.
hST must be valid.
Returns non-zero on success.

functions.name: OGR_SM_AddStyle
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_SM_AddStyle(OGRStyleMgrH hSM, const char *pszStyleName, const char *pszStyleString);
functions.description: Adds a named style to the associated style table, if any.
requirements: hSM must be valid.
pszStyleName and pszStyleString must be non-null.
Returns non-zero on success.

functions.name: OGR_ST_Create
functions.description: Creates a style tool of a given class (pen/brush/symbol/label).
requirements: eClassId must be a valid OGRSTClassId.
Destroy with OGR_ST_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_ST_Destroy
functions.description: Destroys a style tool.
requirements: hST must be valid and not used after destroy.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetType
functions.description: Gets the class/type of a style tool.
requirements: hST must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetUnit
functions.description: Gets the measurement unit used by the style tool.
requirements: hST must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_ST_SetUnit
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_ST_SetUnit(OGRStyleToolH hST, OGRSTUnitId eUnit, double dfGroundPaperScale);
functions.description: Sets the measurement unit and ground/paper scale for the style tool.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eUnit must be a valid OGRSTUnitId.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetParamStr
functions.signature: const char CPL_DLL *OGR_ST_GetParamStr(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, int *bValueIsNull);
functions.description: Gets a string parameter value by param id; indicates nullness via out flag.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam must be a valid parameter identifier for the tool class.
bValueIsNull may be NULL or non-null to receive null state.
Returned string is internal; do not free.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetParamNum
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_ST_GetParamNum(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, int *bValueIsNull);
functions.description: Gets an integer parameter value by id with nullness flag.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam valid for tool.
bValueIsNull may be NULL.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetParamDbl
functions.signature: double CPL_DLL OGR_ST_GetParamDbl(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, int *bValueIsNull);
functions.description: Gets a double parameter value by id with nullness flag.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam valid for tool.
bValueIsNull may be NULL.

functions.name: OGR_ST_SetParamStr
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_ST_SetParamStr(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, const char *pszValue);
functions.description: Sets a string parameter value by id.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam valid for tool.
pszValue must be non-null or NULL to clear, per API.

functions.name: OGR_ST_SetParamNum
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_ST_SetParamNum(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, int nValue);
functions.description: Sets an integer parameter value by id.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam valid for tool.

functions.name: OGR_ST_SetParamDbl
functions.signature: void CPL_DLL OGR_ST_SetParamDbl(OGRStyleToolH hST, int eParam, double dfValue);
functions.description: Sets a double parameter value by id.
requirements: hST must be valid.
eParam valid for tool.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetStyleString
functions.description: Gets the style string representation of the style tool (internal).
requirements: hST must be valid.
Do not free/modify returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_ST_GetRGBFromString
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_ST_GetRGBFromString(OGRStyleToolH hST, const char *pszColor, int *pnRed, int *pnGreen, int *pnBlue, int *pnAlpha);
functions.description: Parses a color string into RGBA integer components; returns non-zero on success.
requirements: hST must be valid.
pszColor must be non-null.
Output component pointers must be non-null for components you wish to receive.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_Create
functions.description: Creates an empty style table; caller owns handle.
requirements: Destroy with OGR_STBL_Destroy.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_Destroy
functions.description: Destroys a style table.
requirements: hSTBL must be valid and not used after destroy.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_AddStyle
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_STBL_AddStyle(OGRStyleTableH hStyleTable, const char *pszName, const char *pszStyleString);
functions.description: Adds a named style to the table; returns non-zero on success.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
pszName and pszStyleString must be non-null.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_SaveStyleTable
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_STBL_SaveStyleTable(OGRStyleTableH hStyleTable, const char *pszFilename);
functions.description: Saves the style table to a file; returns non-zero on success.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
pszFilename must be non-null and writable path.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_LoadStyleTable
functions.signature: int CPL_DLL OGR_STBL_LoadStyleTable(OGRStyleTableH hStyleTable, const char *pszFilename);
functions.description: Loads styles from a file into the table; returns non-zero on success.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
pszFilename must be non-null and readable path.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_Find
functions.signature: const char CPL_DLL *OGR_STBL_Find(OGRStyleTableH hStyleTable, const char *pszName);
functions.description: Finds and returns the style string of a named style (internal pointer) or NULL if not found.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
pszName must be non-null.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_ResetStyleStringReading
functions.description: Resets internal iterator for reading style strings sequentially.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_GetNextStyle
functions.description: Gets the next style string from the internal iterator (internal pointer) or NULL when finished.
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
Call OGR_STBL_ResetStyleStringReading to restart iteration.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: OGR_STBL_GetLastStyleName
functions.description: Gets the name of the last style returned by the iterator (internal pointer).
requirements: hStyleTable must be valid.
Do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: OSRAxisEnumToName
functions.description: Returns the canonical string name corresponding to an OGRAxisOrientation enum value.
requirements: eOrientation must be a valid OGRAxisOrientation value.

functions.name: OSRSetPROJSearchPaths
functions.description: Sets the search paths used by PROJ to locate resource files and databases.
requirements: papszPaths must be a NULL-terminated array of const char* strings, or NULL to reset/default (behavior unspecified in this header).
Each path string must be a valid, null-terminated UTF-8 string.

functions.name: OSRGetPROJSearchPaths
functions.description: Returns the current PROJ search paths as a NULL-terminated string list.
requirements: Return value is a NULL-terminated array of strings allocated by the library; freeing responsibility is not specified in this header (typically use CSLDestroy/CPLFree as per GDAL conventions).

functions.name: OSRSetPROJAuxDbPaths
functions.description: Sets auxiliary database search paths for PROJ (e.g., grid files).
requirements: papszPaths must be a NULL-terminated array of const char* strings, or NULL.
Each path must be a valid C string.

functions.name: OSRGetPROJAuxDbPaths
functions.description: Returns the current PROJ auxiliary database search paths as a NULL-terminated string list.
requirements: Return value is a NULL-terminated array of strings allocated by the library; freeing method is not specified here (typically CSLDestroy/CPLFree).

functions.name: OSRSetPROJEnableNetwork
functions.description: Enables or disables PROJ network access for remote resource fetching.
requirements: enabled should be 0 (disable) or non-zero (enable).

functions.name: OSRGetPROJEnableNetwork
functions.description: Gets whether PROJ network access is enabled (non-zero) or disabled (0).

functions.name: OSRGetPROJVersion
functions.description: Retrieves the PROJ library version components.
requirements: pnMajor, pnMinor, pnPatch must be non-NULL pointers to int.

functions.name: OSRNewSpatialReference
functions.description: Creates a new spatial reference object, optionally initialized from WKT.
requirements: pszWKT may be NULL or a valid null-terminated WKT string.

functions.name: OSRCloneGeogCS
functions.description: Creates a new spatial reference containing the Geographic CRS part of the input.
requirements: hSRS must be a valid OGRSpatialReferenceH handle.

functions.name: OSRClone
functions.description: Clones an existing spatial reference object.
requirements: hSRS must be a valid OGRSpatialReferenceH handle.

functions.name: OSRDestroySpatialReference
functions.description: Destroys/releases a spatial reference object created or cloned by OSR functions.
requirements: hSRS must be a handle previously obtained from OSR creation/clone functions.
Must not be used after destruction.

functions.name: OSRReference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of a spatial reference object.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRDereference
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of a spatial reference object.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
Object must still be valid when called; do not pass after final release.

functions.name: OSRRelease
functions.description: Releases a reference to a spatial reference object (potentially destroying it).
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
After this call, do not use hSRS unless another reference remains.

functions.name: OSRValidate
functions.description: Validates the internal consistency of a spatial reference object.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRImportFromEPSG
functions.description: Initializes a spatial reference from an EPSG numeric code.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
nCode should be a positive EPSG code.

functions.name: OSRImportFromEPSGA
functions.description: Initializes from an EPSG code, using axis order as-authority (if applicable).
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
nCode should be a positive EPSG code.

functions.name: OSRImportFromWkt
functions.description: Parses WKT text and initializes the spatial reference. May advance the input string pointer.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
ppszInput must be non-NULL; *ppszInput must point to a null-terminated WKT string.

functions.name: OSRImportFromProj4
functions.description: Initializes the spatial reference from a PROJ.4 string.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszProj4 must be a valid null-terminated string.

functions.name: OSRImportFromESRI
functions.description: Initializes from ESRI .prj-like name/value string list.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
papszNV must be a NULL-terminated list of strings (CSL).

functions.name: OSRImportFromPCI
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromPCI(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszProj, const char *pszUnits, double *padfPrjParams)
functions.description: Initializes from PCI projection info (projection name, units, and parameter array).
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszProj and pszUnits must be valid strings.
padfPrjParams must point to an array of required numeric parameters (length and semantics are not specified here).

functions.name: OSRImportFromUSGS
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromUSGS(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, long iProjSys, long iZone, double *padfPrjParams, long iDatum)
functions.description: Initializes from USGS GCTP-style parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
padfPrjParams must point to an array sized as required by the projection system (unspecified here).

functions.name: OSRImportFromXML
functions.description: Initializes the spatial reference from an XML representation.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszXML must be a valid null-terminated XML string.

functions.name: OSRImportFromDict
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromDict(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszDict, const char *pszCode)
functions.description: Initializes from a dict database entry (e.g., a named entry in a dictionary file).
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszDict and pszCode must be valid strings.

functions.name: OSRImportFromPanorama
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromPanorama(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, long iProj, long iDatum, long iUnit, double *padfProjParams)
functions.description: Initializes from GIS Panorama (Panorama GIS) projection parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
padfProjParams must point to an array of required parameters.

functions.name: OSRImportFromOzi
functions.description: Initializes from OziExplorer projection definition lines.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
papszLines must be a NULL-terminated list of strings.

functions.name: OSRImportFromMICoordSys
functions.description: Initializes from a MapInfo CoordSys string.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszCoordSys must be a valid string.

functions.name: OSRImportFromERM
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromERM(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszPROJ, const char *pszDATUM, const char *pszUNITS)
functions.description: Initializes from ER Mapper projection, datum, and units strings.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
All input strings must be valid.

functions.name: OSRImportFromUrl
functions.description: Initializes from a URL that references a CRS definition (e.g., authority code).
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszUrl must be a valid string.
Network access and remote fetching may be required depending on URL and configuration.

functions.name: OSRImportFromCF1
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRImportFromCF1(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, CSLConstList papszKeyValues, const char *pszUnits)
functions.description: Initializes from CF-1.x metadata key/value list and units.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
papszKeyValues must be a NULL-terminated list of strings.
pszUnits must be a valid string or NULL.

functions.name: OSRExportToWkt
functions.description: Exports the spatial reference to WKT. Allocates a new string into *ppszResult.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszResult must be non-NULL; on success, *ppszResult receives an allocated string (freeing method not specified here; typically CPLFree).

functions.name: OSRExportToWktEx
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToWktEx(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszResult, const char *const *papszOptions)
functions.description: Exports to WKT with options controlling formatting.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszResult must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.
papszOptions is a NULL-terminated list of strings or NULL.

functions.name: OSRExportToPrettyWkt
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToPrettyWkt(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszResult, int bSimplify)
functions.description: Exports to nicely formatted WKT (optionally simplified).
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszResult must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.
bSimplify is 0/1.

functions.name: OSRExportToPROJJSON
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToPROJJSON(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszReturn, const char *const *papszOptions)
functions.description: Exports to a PROJJSON representation.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszReturn must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.
papszOptions is a NULL-terminated list or NULL.

functions.name: OSRExportToProj4
functions.description: Exports to a legacy PROJ.4 string.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszResult must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.

functions.name: OSRExportToPCI
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToPCI(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszProj, char **ppszUnits, double **ppadfPrjParams)
functions.description: Exports to PCI projection name, units, and parameter array.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszProj, ppszUnits, ppadfPrjParams must be non-NULL pointers that will receive allocated outputs.

functions.name: OSRExportToUSGS
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToUSGS(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, long *piProjSys, long *piZone, double **ppadfPrjParams, long *piDatum)
functions.description: Exports to USGS GCTP-style parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
All output pointers must be non-NULL as needed; ppadfPrjParams receives allocated array.

functions.name: OSRExportToXML
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToXML(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszRawXML, const char *pszDialect)
functions.description: Exports to an XML representation in a specified dialect.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszRawXML must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.
pszDialect may be NULL or a valid dialect name.

functions.name: OSRExportToPanorama
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToPanorama(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, long *piProj, long *piDatum, long *piUnit, long *piZone, double *padfProjParams)
functions.description: Exports to GIS Panorama projection parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
All output pointers must be non-NULL.
padfProjParams must point to an array of sufficient size to receive parameters (size unspecified here).

functions.name: OSRExportToMICoordSys
functions.description: Exports to a MapInfo CoordSys string.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszResult must be non-NULL; receives allocated string.

functions.name: OSRExportToERM
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToERM(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char *pszPROJ, char *pszDATUM, char *pszUNITS)
functions.description: Exports to ER Mapper projection, datum, and units strings (into provided buffers).
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
pszPROJ, pszDATUM, pszUNITS must point to writable buffers large enough to hold outputs (sizes unspecified here).

functions.name: OSRExportToCF1
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRExportToCF1(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, char **ppszGridMappingName, char ***ppapszKeyValues, char **ppszUnits, CSLConstList papszOptions)
functions.description: Exports to CF-1.x grid_mapping name, key/value pairs, and units.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
Output pointers must be non-NULL to receive allocated results.
papszOptions is a NULL-terminated string list or NULL.

functions.name: OSRMorphToESRI
functions.description: Alters the SRS in-place to an ESRI-compatible form.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRMorphFromESRI
functions.description: Converts an ESRI-form SRS back to a standard form in-place.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRStripVertical
functions.description: Removes any vertical component from a compound CRS.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRConvertToOtherProjection
functions.signature: OGRSpatialReferenceH OSRConvertToOtherProjection(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszTargetProjection, const char *const *papszOptions)
functions.description: Creates a new SRS converted to another projection method, using options if provided.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
pszTargetProjection must be a valid string naming a projection method.
papszOptions is a NULL-terminated list or NULL.

functions.name: OSRGetName
functions.description: Returns the name/title of the SRS, if available.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRGetCelestialBodyName
functions.description: Returns the name of the celestial body for the CRS (e.g., "Earth"), if available.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRSetAttrValue
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetAttrValue(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszNodePath, const char *pszNewNodeValue)
functions.description: Sets a node value by path in the internal representation of the SRS.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszNodePath must be a valid string path.
pszNewNodeValue may be NULL or a valid string depending on usage.

functions.name: OSRGetAttrValue
functions.signature: const char *OSRGetAttrValue(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszName, int iChild)
functions.description: Gets a node or attribute value by name and optional child index.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
pszName must be a valid string.
iChild is a zero-based index.

functions.name: OSRSetAngularUnits
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetAngularUnits(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszUnits, double dfConvertToRadians)
functions.description: Sets the angular unit name and conversion factor to radians.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszUnits must be a valid string.
dfConvertToRadians should be positive.

functions.name: OSRGetAngularUnits
functions.description: Gets the angular unit conversion factor to radians and optionally its name.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszName may be NULL or non-NULL to receive a pointer to a unit name (allocation ownership unspecified here).

functions.name: OSRSetLinearUnits
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetLinearUnits(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszUnits, double dfInMeters)
functions.description: Sets the linear unit name and conversion factor to meters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszUnits must be a valid string.
dfInMeters should be positive.

functions.name: OSRSetTargetLinearUnits
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetTargetLinearUnits(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszTargetKey, const char *pszUnits, double dfInMeters)
functions.description: Sets linear units for a specific target node (e.g., PROJCS).
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszTargetKey and pszUnits must be valid strings.
dfInMeters should be positive.

functions.name: OSRSetLinearUnitsAndUpdateParameters
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetLinearUnitsAndUpdateParameters(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszUnits, double dfInMeters)
functions.description: Sets linear units and updates projection parameters accordingly.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszUnits must be a valid string.
dfInMeters should be positive.

functions.name: OSRGetLinearUnits
functions.description: Gets the linear unit conversion factor to meters and optionally its name.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszName may be NULL or non-NULL to receive a pointer to a unit name.

functions.name: OSRGetTargetLinearUnits
functions.description: Gets linear units for a specific target node and optionally its name.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
pszTargetKey must be a valid string.
ppszName may be NULL or non-NULL.

functions.name: OSRGetPrimeMeridian
functions.description: Gets the prime meridian value (degrees offset from Greenwich) and optionally its name.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.
ppszName may be NULL or non-NULL.

functions.name: OSRIsGeographic
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the SRS is geographic (lat/long).
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRIsDerivedGeographic
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the SRS is a derived geographic CRS.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRIsLocal
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the SRS is local/engineering.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRIsProjected
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the SRS is a projected CRS.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OSRIsDerivedProjected
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the SRS is a derived projected CRS.
requirements: hSRS must be valid.

requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetTMVariant
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetTMVariant(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, const char *pszVariantName, double dfCenterLat, double dfCenterLong, double dfScale, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures a Transverse Mercator variant by name and parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
pszVariantName must be a valid string.

functions.name: OSRSetTMG
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetTMG(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfCenterLat, double dfCenterLong, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Tunisia Mining Grid parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetTMSO
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetTMSO(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfCenterLat, double dfCenterLong, double dfScale, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Transverse Mercator South Oriented parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetTPED
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetTPED(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfLat1, double dfLong1, double dfLat2, double dfLong2, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Two Point Equidistant projection parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetVDG
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetVDG(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfCenterLong, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Van Der Grinten parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetWagner
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetWagner(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, int nVariation, double dfCenterLat, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Wagner projections I–VII by variation index.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.
nVariation must select a valid Wagner variant (unspecified here).

functions.name: OSRSetQSC
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetQSC(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfCenterLat, double dfCenterLong)
functions.description: Configures Quadrilateralized Spherical Cube parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetSCH
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetSCH(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfPegLat, double dfPegLong, double dfPegHeading, double dfPegHgt)
functions.description: Configures Spherical, Cross-track, Height parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRSetVerticalPerspective
functions.signature: OGRErr OSRSetVerticalPerspective(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSRS, double dfTopoOriginLat, double dfTopoOriginLon, double dfTopoOriginHeight, double dfViewPointHeight, double dfFalseEasting, double dfFalseNorthing)
functions.description: Configures Vertical/Near-sided Perspective parameters.
requirements: hSRS must be valid and modifiable.

functions.name: OSRCalcInvFlattening
functions.description: Computes inverse flattening from semi-major and semi-minor axes.
requirements: dfSemiMajor > 0.
dfSemiMinor > 0 and <= dfSemiMajor.

functions.name: OSRCalcSemiMinorFromInvFlattening
functions.description: Computes semi-minor axis from semi-major axis and inverse flattening.
requirements: dfSemiMajor > 0.
dfInvFlattening >= 0.

functions.name: OSRCleanup
functions.description: Cleans up internal OSR/PROJ-related resources for the process.
requirements: Should typically be called once at process shutdown if needed; not re-entrant (details unspecified).

functions.name: OSRGetCRSInfoListFromDatabase
functions.description: Returns a list of CRS info records from the database for the given authority.
requirements: pszAuthName may be NULL or a valid authority name string.
params currently unused; may be NULL.
pnOutResultCount must be non-NULL.
Returned list must be freed with OSRDestroyCRSInfoList.

functions.name: OSRDestroyCRSInfoList
functions.description: Destroys a list returned by OSRGetCRSInfoListFromDatabase.
requirements: list must be the pointer returned by OSRGetCRSInfoListFromDatabase or NULL.

functions.name: OSRGetAuthorityListFromDatabase
functions.description: Returns a NULL-terminated list of available CRS authorities in the database.
requirements: Returned list is allocated by the library; freeing mechanism not specified here (typically CSLDestroy).

functions.name: OCTNewCoordinateTransformation
functions.description: Creates a new 3D coordinate transformation between source and target SRS.
requirements: hSourceSRS and hTargetSRS must be valid.

functions.name: OCTNewCoordinateTransformationOptions
functions.description: Creates a new options object for configuring coordinate transformations.

functions.name: OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetOperation
functions.signature: int OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetOperation(OGRCoordinateTransformationOptionsH hOptions, const char *pszCO, int bReverseCO)
functions.description: Selects a specific PROJ operation by name or definition, with optional reversal, for the transformation.
requirements: hOptions must be valid.
pszCO must be a valid string.
bReverseCO is 0/1.

functions.name: OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetAreaOfInterest
functions.signature: int OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetAreaOfInterest(OGRCoordinateTransformationOptionsH hOptions, double dfWestLongitudeDeg, double dfSouthLatitudeDeg, double dfEastLongitudeDeg, double dfNorthLatitudeDeg)
functions.description: Sets an area of interest to guide operation selection.
requirements: hOptions must be valid.
Coordinates are degrees; longitudes/latitudes should be within valid ranges.

functions.name: OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetDesiredAccuracy
functions.description: Sets desired accuracy (in meters) to guide operation selection.
requirements: hOptions must be valid.
dfAccuracy should be >= 0.

functions.name: OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetBallparkAllowed
functions.description: Sets whether lower-accuracy ballpark operations are allowed.
requirements: hOptions must be valid.
bAllowBallpark is 0/1.

functions.name: OCTCoordinateTransformationOptionsSetOnlyBest
functions.description: Sets whether only the best-scoring operation should be selected.
requirements: hOptions must be valid.

functions.name: OCTDestroyCoordinateTransformationOptions
functions.description: Destroys a transformation options object.
requirements: hOptions must be a valid handle or NULL.
Do not use after destruction.

functions.name: OCTNewCoordinateTransformationEx
functions.signature: OGRCoordinateTransformationH OCTNewCoordinateTransformationEx(OGRSpatialReferenceH hSourceSRS, OGRSpatialReferenceH hTargetSRS, OGRCoordinateTransformationOptionsH hOptions)
functions.description: Creates a new coordinate transformation with explicit options.
requirements: hSourceSRS and hTargetSRS must be valid.
hOptions may be NULL or a valid options handle.

functions.name: OCTClone
functions.description: Clones a coordinate transformation object.
requirements: hTransform must be valid.

functions.name: OCTGetSourceCS
functions.description: Returns the source SRS of a transformation.
requirements: hTransform must be valid.

functions.name: OCTGetTargetCS
functions.description: Returns the target SRS of a transformation.
requirements: hTransform must be valid.

functions.name: OCTGetInverse
functions.description: Returns an inverse transformation object if available.
requirements: hTransform must be valid.

functions.name: OCTDestroyCoordinateTransformation
functions.description: Destroys a coordinate transformation object.
requirements: hCT must be a valid handle created by OCT* creation functions.
Do not use after destruction.

functions.name: OCTTransform
functions.signature: int OCTTransform(OGRCoordinateTransformationH hCT, int nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z)
functions.description: Transforms arrays of 3D points in-place from source to target SRS.
requirements: hCT must be valid.
nCount >= 0.
x, y must point to arrays of length >= nCount.
z may be NULL or an array of length >= nCount depending on dimensionality.

functions.name: OCTTransformEx
functions.signature: int OCTTransformEx(OGRCoordinateTransformationH hCT, int nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z, int *pabSuccess)
functions.description: Transforms arrays of points with per-point success flags.
requirements: hCT must be valid.
nCount >= 0.
x, y arrays length >= nCount.
z may be NULL or length >= nCount.
pabSuccess must be NULL or point to an int array length >= nCount.

functions.name: OCTTransform4D
functions.signature: int OCTTransform4D(OGRCoordinateTransformationH hCT, int nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z, double *t, int *pabSuccess)
functions.description: Transforms arrays of 4D coordinates (including time).
requirements: hCT must be valid.
nCount >= 0.
x, y arrays length >= nCount.
z and t may be NULL or arrays length >= nCount.
pabSuccess may be NULL or length >= nCount.

functions.name: OCTTransform4DWithErrorCodes
functions.signature: int OCTTransform4DWithErrorCodes(OGRCoordinateTransformationH hCT, int nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z, double *t, int *panErrorCodes)
functions.description: Transforms 4D coordinates returning per-point error codes.
requirements: hCT must be valid.
nCount >= 0.
x, y arrays length >= nCount.
z and t may be NULL or arrays length >= nCount.
panErrorCodes must be NULL or length >= nCount.

functions.name: OCTTransformBounds
functions.signature: int OCTTransformBounds(OGRCoordinateTransformationH hCT, const double xmin, const double ymin, const double xmax, const double ymax, double *out_xmin, double *out_ymin, double *out_xmax, double *out_ymax, const int densify_pts)
functions.description: Transforms an axis-aligned bounding box from source to target SRS, optionally densifying edges to improve accuracy.
requirements: hCT must be valid.
Input bounds must be finite numeric values with xmin <= xmax and ymin <= ymax.
Output pointers must be non-NULL.
densify_pts >= 0.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::Listener::~Listener
functions.description: Virtual destructor for OGR_SRSNode::Listener to allow safe deletion through base-pointer. Called automatically when a Listener implementation is destroyed.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::Listener::notifyChange
functions.description: Pure-virtual callback invoked when an OGR_SRSNode is modified. Implement this in user code to observe changes to a node tree.
requirements: Must be implemented by derived classes before use (pure virtual).
The node pointer passed may refer to the node that changed; do not retain beyond callback scope unless the application manages lifetimes.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::OGR_SRSNode
functions.description: Constructs a WKT parse tree node with an optional initial value string.
requirements: If pszValue is non-null, it should point to a valid, null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::~OGR_SRSNode
functions.description: Destructor. Releases internal value and child nodes and unregisters any listener.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::RegisterListener
functions.description: Registers a single Listener object to be notified when this node is modified.
requirements: listener must be a valid shared_ptr to a Listener implementation.
Only a single listener is maintained (subsequent calls replace previous).

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::IsLeafNode
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the node has no children.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::GetChildCount
functions.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::GetChild
functions.description: Returns the iChild-th child node (mutable).
requirements: iChild must be in the range [0, GetChildCount()-1].

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::GetNode
functions.description: Finds and returns the first descendant node matching pszName (mutable). Exact matching semantics are not fully documented here.
requirements: pszName must be a non-null, null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::InsertChild
functions.description: Inserts poChild at index nChildPos among the children of this node.
requirements: poChild must be a non-null pointer to a heap-allocated OGR_SRSNode not already parented elsewhere.
nChildPos must be in the range [0, GetChildCount()].

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::AddChild
functions.description: Appends poChild as the last child of this node.
requirements: poChild must be a non-null pointer to a heap-allocated OGR_SRSNode not already parented elsewhere.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::FindChild
functions.description: Returns the index of the first immediate child whose value matches pszName, or -1 if not found.
requirements: pszName must be a non-null, null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::DestroyChild
functions.description: Destroys and removes the child at position nChildPos.
requirements: nChildPos must be in the range [0, GetChildCount()-1].

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::ClearChildren
functions.description: Destroys and removes all children of this node.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::StripNodes
functions.description: Removes all descendant nodes with the specified name.
requirements: pszName must be a non-null, null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::GetValue
functions.description: Returns the node's value string. The returned pointer remains valid while the node is alive and its value is not modified.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::SetValue
functions.description: Sets the node's value string to pszNewValue.
requirements: pszNewValue must be a non-null, null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::MakeValueSafe
functions.description: Alters the node value for safe WKT serialization (e.g., quoting/escaping). Precise behavior not documented here.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::Clone
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of this node and its subtree. Caller owns the returned pointer.
requirements: Caller must delete the returned node to avoid memory leaks.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::importFromWkt
functions.description: Parses a WKT string in-place from ppszInput into this node. Deprecated signature; use importFromWkt(const char**).
requirements: ppszInput must be non-null and point to a modifiable C string pointer. The pointer may be advanced by the parser.
Deprecated: prefer the const char** overload.

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::exportToWkt
functions.description: Serializes this node subtree to a newly allocated WKT string.
requirements: ppszOutput must be non-null. On success, *ppszOutput receives an allocated C string that the caller must free with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGR_SRSNode::exportToPrettyWkt
functions.description: Serializes this node subtree to a formatted (pretty) WKT string. Optional simplification flag.
requirements: ppszOutput must be non-null. On success, *ppszOutput receives an allocated C string that the caller must free with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::OGRSpatialReference
functions.description: Constructs a new spatial reference object, optionally initializing it from a WKT string.
requirements: If pszWKT is non-null, it must point to a null-terminated WKT string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::~OGRSpatialReference
functions.description: Destructor. Releases internal resources. Objects are normally reference-counted; prefer Release().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::DestroySpatialReference
functions.description: Static helper to destroy a spatial reference, typically calling Release() if non-null.
requirements: poSRS may be null. If non-null, should be a pointer obtained from GDAL/OSR APIs.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::operator=
functions.description: Copy assignment operator. Copies the content of another OGRSpatialReference.
requirements: The source object must remain valid during assignment.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::AssignAndSetThreadSafe
functions.description: Assigns from other and configures internal state for thread-safe use. Exact semantics are library-internal.
requirements: other must be a valid, initialized OGRSpatialReference.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::Reference
functions.description: Increments the internal reference count and returns it.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::Dereference
functions.description: Decrements the internal reference count and returns it.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::GetReferenceCount
functions.description: Returns the current reference count.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::Release
functions.description: Decrements reference count and deletes the object if it reaches zero.
requirements: After Release() reduces count to zero, the pointer must not be used further.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::GetName
functions.description: Returns a human-readable name of the SRS if available, else null or empty. Exact source depends on current state (e.g., PROJCS/GEOGCS name).

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::Clone
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of this spatial reference. Caller owns the returned object (reference count initialized appropriately).
requirements: Caller must Release() the returned object when done.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::CloneGeogCS
functions.description: Returns a clone of the geographic CRS component of this SRS, if any.
requirements: Returns nullptr on failure; caller must Release() the returned object when no longer needed.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::dumpReadable
functions.description: Dumps a human-readable representation of the SRS to the debug output (CPLError/printf). Intended for debugging.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToWkt
functions.description: Serializes this SRS to a WKT string (newly allocated).
requirements: ppszWKT must be non-null. On success, *ppszWKT must be freed with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToPrettyWkt
functions.description: Serializes this SRS to a formatted (pretty) WKT string. Optional simplification flag.
requirements: ppszWKT must be non-null. On success, *ppszWKT must be freed with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToPROJJSON
functions.description: Exports this SRS to a PROJJSON string. Options control formatting.
requirements: ppszPROJJSON must be non-null. On success, *ppszPROJJSON must be freed with CPLFree().
papszOptions may be null or a valid CSL.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToProj4
functions.description: Exports this SRS to a PROJ.4 string. Note: some SRS constructs may not round-trip perfectly.
requirements: ppszProj4 must be non-null. On success, *ppszProj4 must be freed with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToPCI
functions.description: Exports this SRS to PCI Geomatics coordinate system definition components.
requirements: ppszProj, ppszUnits, ppadfParm must be non-null. On success, returned pointers must be freed per GDAL/CPL memory rules.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToUSGS
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::exportToUSGS(long *piProjSys, long *piZone, double **ppadfPrjParams, long *piDatum) const
functions.description: Exports this SRS to USGS GCTP-like parameters.
requirements: All output pointers must be non-null. The allocated parameter arrays must be freed according to GDAL's rules.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToXML
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::exportToXML(char **ppszRawXML, const char *pszDialect = nullptr) const
functions.description: Exports this SRS to an XML representation (e.g., GML or WKT XML variants).
requirements: ppszRawXML must be non-null. On success, *ppszRawXML must be freed with CPLFree().
pszDialect may be null or a valid null-terminated C string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToPanorama
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::exportToPanorama(long *piProjSys, long *piZone, long *piEllips, long *piDatum, double *padfPrjParams) const
functions.description: Exports this SRS to Erdas Panorama parameters.
requirements: All output pointers must be non-null.
padfPrjParams must point to an array sized as required by the format (exact size not documented here).

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportVertCSToPanorama
functions.description: Exports this SRS's vertical CS to Panorama code.
requirements: piVertCS must be non-null.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToERM
functions.description: Exports to ER Mapper projection/datum/units short codes, writing into caller-provided buffers.
requirements: pszProj, pszDatum, pszUnits must be non-null and point to sufficiently large writable buffers. Required sizes not documented here.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToMICoordSys
functions.description: Exports to MapInfo MI CoordSys string.
requirements: ppszMICS must be non-null. On success, *ppszMICS must be freed with CPLFree().

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::exportToCF1
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::exportToCF1(char **ppszGridMappingName, char ***ppapszKeyValues, char **ppszUnits, CSLConstList papszOptions) const
functions.description: Exports to CF-1 (netCDF) grid_mapping attributes, returning mapping name, key/value pairs and units.
requirements: ppszGridMappingName, ppapszKeyValues, ppszUnits must be non-null. Returned allocations must be freed per GDAL rules.
papszOptions may be null or a CSL.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromWkt
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from a WKT string (deprecated in-place signature).
requirements: ppszInput must be non-null and point to a modifiable C string pointer.
Deprecated: prefer const char** or const char* overloads.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromProj4
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from a PROJ.4 string.
requirements: pszProj4 must be a non-null, null-terminated PROJ.4 definition.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromEPSG
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from an EPSG code (typically CRS code).
requirements: nEPSGCode should be a valid EPSG CRS code.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromEPSGA
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from an EPSG code, with axis-ordering adjustments (EPSGA semantics).
requirements: nEPSGCode should be a valid EPSG CRS code.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromESRI
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from ESRI .prj-style WKT lines.
requirements: papszPrj must be a null-terminated array of C strings (CSL).

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromPCI
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::importFromPCI(const char *pszProj, const char *pszUnits = nullptr, const double *padfPrjParams = nullptr)
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from PCI Geomatics parameters.
requirements: pszProj must be non-null.
pszUnits may be null or non-null string.
padfPrjParams may be null or point to an array sized per PCI expectations.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromUSGS
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::importFromUSGS(long iProjSys, long iZone, double *padfPrjParams, long iDatum, int nUSGSAngleFormat = USGS_ANGLE_PACKEDDMS)
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from USGS GCTP-like parameters.
requirements: padfPrjParams must point to an array sized as required by the projection.
nUSGSAngleFormat must be one of USGS_ANGLE_DECIMALDEGREES, USGS_ANGLE_PACKEDDMS, or USGS_ANGLE_RADIANS.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromPanorama
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::importFromPanorama(long iProjSys, long iProjZone, long iEllips, double *padfPrjParams, bool bNorth = true)
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from Erdas Panorama parameters.
requirements: padfPrjParams must be a valid pointer to required-length array.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importVertCSFromPanorama
functions.description: Initializes this SRS's vertical CS from a Panorama vertical code.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromOzi
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from OziExplorer .map lines.
requirements: papszLines must be a null-terminated array of C strings.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromWMSAUTO
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from a WMSAUTO definition string.
requirements: pszAutoDef must be a non-null, null-terminated string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromXML
functions.description: Initializes this SRS by parsing an XML representation.
requirements: pszXML must be a non-null, null-terminated XML string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromDict
functions.description: Initializes this SRS by looking up an entry in a dictionary file.
requirements: pszDict and pszCode must be non-null strings referencing a known dictionary and code.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromURN
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from an OGC URN string (e.g., urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326).
requirements: pszURN must be a non-null, null-terminated string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromCRSURL
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from an OGC CRS URL.
requirements: pszURL must be a non-null, null-terminated string with a supported scheme.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromERM
functions.signature: OGRErr OGRSpatialReference::importFromERM(const char *pszProj, const char *pszDatum, const char *pszUnits)
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from ER Mapper projection/datum/units codes.
requirements: pszProj, pszDatum, pszUnits must be non-null strings.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromUrl
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from the content referenced by a URL (e.g., a WKT/PROJJSON resource).
requirements: pszURL must be a non-null, valid URL string.
Network/file access must be available to resolve the URL.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromMICoordSys
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from a MapInfo MI CoordSys string.
requirements: pszMICS must be a non-null, null-terminated string.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::importFromCF1
functions.description: Initializes this SRS from CF-1 grid_mapping key/value pairs and units.
requirements: papszKeyValues must be a null-terminated array of strings in key=value form.
pszUnits must be non-null.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::morphToESRI
functions.description: Rewrites the SRS WKT to ESRI-style conventions where appropriate.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::morphFromESRI
functions.description: Rewrites an ESRI-style SRS into standard GDAL/OGC WKT conventions.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::convertToOtherProjection
functions.signature: OGRSpatialReference *OGRSpatialReference::convertToOtherProjection(const char *pszTargetProjection, const char *const *papszOptions = nullptr) const
functions.description: Returns a new SRS converted to the specified projection by name, applying reasonable defaults. Intended for convenience conversions.
requirements: pszTargetProjection must be a non-null string identifying a supported projection method.
papszOptions may be null or a CSL.
Caller must Release() the returned object.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::Validate
functions.description: Validates internal consistency of this SRS definition.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::StripVertical
functions.description: Removes any vertical coordinate system component from this SRS.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::StripTOWGS84IfKnownDatumAndAllowed
functions.description: Removes TOWGS84 transformation parameters if a known datum and policy allow it.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::StripTOWGS84IfKnownDatum
functions.description: Removes TOWGS84 transformation parameters if a known datum is detected.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::EPSGTreatsAsLatLong
functions.description: Returns non-zero if EPSG definition treats axes as (lat,lon) for this CRS.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::EPSGTreatsAsNorthingEasting
functions.description: Returns non-zero if EPSG definition treats axes as (northing,easting) for this CRS.

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::GetAxesCount
functions.description: Returns the number of axes of this CRS (typically 2 or 3).

functions.name: OGRSpatialReference::GetAxis
functions.signature: const char *OGRSpatialReference::GetAxis(const char *pszTargetKey, int iAxis, OGRAxisOrientation *peOrientation, double *pdfConvFactor = nullptr) const

functions.name: OGRCoordinateTransformation::Transform
functions.signature: int OGRCoordinateTransformation::Transform(size_t nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z = nullptr, int *pabSuccess = nullptr)
functions.description: Transforms nCount points in-place from source to target CRS using x,y,(optional z). Returns TRUE on success, FALSE if any failed. If pabSuccess is provided, it is filled per-point.
requirements: x and y must be non-null arrays of length >= nCount.
z may be null or an array of length >= nCount.
pabSuccess may be null or an array of length >= nCount.

functions.name: OGRCoordinateTransformation::TransformWithErrorCodes
functions.signature: virtual int OGRCoordinateTransformation::TransformWithErrorCodes(size_t nCount, double *x, double *y, double *z, double *t, int *panErrorCodes)
functions.description: Transforms nCount points in-place, returning PROJ public error codes per point in panErrorCodes. Returns TRUE if all succeeded, FALSE otherwise.
requirements: x and y must be non-null arrays of length >= nCount.
z and t may be null or arrays of length >= nCount.
panErrorCodes may be null or an array of length >= nCount.

functions.name: OGRCoordinateTransformation::TransformBounds

functions.description: Transforms an input bounding box to the target CRS, densifying edges to account for non-linearities, and outputs the outer bounds. Default base implementation reports failure.
requirements: out_xmin, out_ymin, out_xmax, out_ymax must be non-null.
